titles.overview: New York mafia capo Dwight "The General" Manfredi is released from prison after 25 years and exiled by his boss to set up shop in Tulsa, Oklahoma. Realizing that his mob family may not have his best interests in mind, Dwight slowly builds a crew.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Dwight "The General" Manfredi is the American Mafia capo from New York City who has just finished serving a 25-year prison sentence. Upon release, Dwight's boss sends him to Tulsa, Oklahoma, to establish criminal operations there.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: In season two, Dwight and his crew continue to build up and defend their growing empire in Tulsa but, just as they get their bearings, they realize that they're not the only ones who want to stake their claim. With looming threats from the Kansas City mob and a very powerful local businessman, Dwight struggles to keep his family and crew safe while keeping track of all his affairs. Plus, he still has unfinished business back in New York.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: In season three, as Dwight's empire expands, so do his enemies and the risks to his crew. Now, he faces his most dangerous adversaries in Tulsa yet: the Dunmires, a powerful old-money family that doesn't play by old-world rules, forcing Dwight to fight for everything he's built and protect his family.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: In season four, Dwight fights to legitimize his empire and protect his crew as corrupt politicians, dangerous new enemies, and a crushing personal loss hit from every direction. However, every hard-won gain comes with even harder truths: about loyalty, leadership and the cost of ambition. Each move drags Dwight deeper into the street instincts he left behind in New York - turning Tulsa into a battleground and Dwight into the one threat no one can afford to underestimate.

titles.overview: Jack Reacher, a veteran military police investigator, has just recently entered civilian life. Reacher is a drifter, carrying no phone and the barest of essentials as he travels the country and explores the nation he once served.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Based on "Killing Floor," when retired Military Police Officer Jack Reacher is arrested for a murder he did not commit, he finds himself in the middle of a deadly conspiracy full of dirty cops, shady businessmen and scheming politicians. With nothing but his wits, he must figure out what is happening in Margrave, Georgia.

seasons.name: Season 3

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Based on "Gone Tomorrow," when a chance encounter with a distraught stranger on a subway goes horribly wrong, Jack Reacher is drawn into a complex and deadly game that pits him against ruthless foes from the highest echelons of power.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Set in an alternate America where witches ended their persecution nearly 300 years ago by cutting a deal with the U.S. government to fight for their country, “Motherland: Fort Salem” follows three young women from basic training in combat magic into early deployment.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Raelle, Tally and Abigail confront higher stakes, dangerous magic and a new threat from an ancient group of witch hunters, The Camarilla. Their training is intensified when they are promoted to attend War College, where their magic, relationships and beliefs will be pushed to the limits. While General Alder seeks out new witches to join the wars to come, The Spree and the Army learn their fight may no longer be with one another.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Without a military nor a home, Abigail, Tally, Raelle and Scylla seek protection alongside the Dodger community in the Cession — but laying low and staying out of trouble has never been their strong suit. With witch hunters working against them from inside the White House, our heroes must call upon ancient forces in the final battle for their right to exist.

episodes.name: Say the Words
episodes.overview: Set in an alternate America where witches ended their persecution over 300 years ago by cutting a deal with the burgeoning government to fight for their country, the series follows three young women from basic training in combat magic into early deployment. In this world, the traditional roles of gender and power are flipped, with the more dominant women on the front lines fighting looming terrorist threats that are familiar to our world, but with supernatural tactics and weapons.

episodes.name: My Witches
episodes.overview: The unit travels to Salem Town for an annual witch celebration, but an unexpected disturbance throws the proceedings into chaos. Tally wonders if she made the right choice to embark on a military career when witch-hate and her own mother stand in her way. Smarting from Alder’s denial of her request to switch units, Abigail attempts to bury the hatchet with Raelle. Raelle grows closer to Scylla, while the unit impresses Anacostia in Windstrike training.

episodes.name: A Biddy's Life
episodes.overview: Fort Salem excitedly greets male visitors on the eve of Beltane, but Raelle and Scylla’s budding romance is interrupted by the arrival of a mysterious man from Scylla’s past. One of the male witches catches Tally’s eye, but she is unsure of how to proceed. Meanwhile, Alder attempts to convince the Hague, an international military council of witches, to follow her strategy against the Spree and is startled by the news of an escalating humanitarian crisis in the Tarim Basin.

episodes.name: Hail Beltane
episodes.overview: The base reels from a traumatic event, while Raelle tries to come to terms with her role in the tragedy. Scylla attempts to evade Raelle’s increasingly pointed questions. Abigail works to impress her formidable rival, Libba. And Tally’s connection with Gerit grows during Beltane, a sacred holiday honoring fertility traditions.

episodes.name: Bellweather Season
episodes.overview: The unit travels off base for the high society wedding of Abigail’s cousin. Raelle throws herself into her relationship with Scylla, who, unbeknownst to Raelle, faces an impossible choice. Abigail becomes disillusioned with her privilege while amongst the notable Bellweather line. And Tally gets hit with two life-altering revelations that change the very fabric of the unit.

episodes.name: Up Is Down
episodes.overview: Abigail has to come to terms with her vulnerability in the aftermath of a horrific event. Tally struggles with being supportive while also keeping a secret from her unit. Raelle takes extreme measures to connect with Scylla.

episodes.name: Mother Mycelium
episodes.overview: Abigail forges a connection with Adil, a new visitor to base camp, and pushes a devastated Raelle to help him save a life. Tally uses Gerit as a distraction from her increasingly burdensome secrets. Anacostia probes into Scylla’s past.

episodes.name: Citydrop
episodes.overview: The witches’ training culminates at City Drop, their final training exercise. Devastating secrets come to light, splintering the unit and forcing Tally to question her blind trust. A looming Spree threat changes the course of the cadets’ lives.

episodes.name: Coup
episodes.overview: In the aftermath of Citydrop, the unit comes closer together, while their distrust of Alder grows. Abigail is faced with eulogizing a fallen soldier, while Tally learns something new about Gerit. Anacostia grants one last favor to Scylla.

episodes.name: Witchbomb
episodes.overview: Raelle, Abigail, and Tally graduate from Basic Training making Abigail more desperate than ever to prove her unit belongs in War College. Alder eyes the unit for a rescue mission while Anacostia and Scylla find common ground. Season finale.

episodes.name: Of the Blood
episodes.overview: Despite the threat of the Camarilla, the discovery of new witches gives Alder hope; Tally struggles with her role as a Biddy; Raelle and Abigail return to Fort Salem with their mysterious new abilities.

episodes.name: Abomination
episodes.overview: The Unit begins War College, introducing them to their Coven and new challenges; Anacostia and Scylla find themselves unlikely partners in a dangerous mission; Tally mentors a new recruit.

episodes.name: A Tiffany
episodes.overview: Raelle prepares to show her ability to the top brass, while Abigail struggles with her new role. Tally begins to question her unsettling dreams. Anacostia and Scylla form a plan to infiltrate the enemy further.

episodes.name: Not Our Daughters
episodes.overview: Anti-witch sentiment boils over as the Unit defends the first witch testing center at its grand opening. Anacostia and Scylla go undercover to follow the Camarilla.

episodes.name: Brianna's Favorite Pencil
episodes.overview: The Unit competes for a chance to commune with the dead during Samhain. Scylla and Anacostia search for Camarilla leadership by attending a Halloween gala and make a horrifying discovery.

episodes.name: My 3 Dads
episodes.overview: Raelle brings Tally home to the Cession, where they struggle with the past. Abigail is confronted with pressure from her family when Adil accompanies her home.

episodes.name: Irrevocable
episodes.overview: Raelle fights for her life, just as the Army and Spree converge on a secret Camarilla stronghold. Abigail and Adil’s mission for vengeance escalates.

episodes.name: Delusional
episodes.overview: Tally leads the unit on a mind-bending mission to find Nicte Batan – but is the unit strong enough to withstand Nicte’s defenses?

episodes.name: Mother of All, Mother of None
episodes.overview: Distrust in Alder grows as Tally and Abigail pressure those in power for changes. Raelle gains a deeper understanding of the Mycelium and its purpose for her.

episodes.name: Revolution (1)
episodes.overview: The Camarilla brings the fight to Fort Salem. Raelle, Abigail, Tally and their allies are forced to make impossible, world-changing choices.

episodes.name: Homo Cantus
episodes.overview: After being blamed for the death of the vice president's daughter, the witches leave the army behind and become fugitives - but staying out of trouble is never easy. While Raelle and Scylla enjoy their reunion, Nicte tempts Tally with a new power.

episodes.name: The Price of Work
episodes.overview: The group seeks sanctuary in the mysterious Cession. The Unit learns the Camarilla is directly targeting the Mycelium, inspiring them to strike back. Petra and Anacostia work to determine President Wade's allegiance.

episodes.name: Oh Elayne...
episodes.overview: With the Cession Marshal on their heels, the Unit splits up. Scylla and Nicte attempt to draw the Marshal away while Tally, Abigail and Adil meet an old ally. President Wade’s political stance puts her in danger.

episodes.name: Happy Yule!
episodes.overview: The Unit spends the Yule holiday plotting their next steps. Alder seeks out another steward of the First Song. Hearst, President Silver and Kara Brandt celebrate a victory.

episodes.name: Cession in Session
episodes.overview: The Council of the Great River convenes to hear the Unit’s testimony and decide whether to extradite them back to the U.S. Abigail attempts to convey the dangers of the Camarilla’s influence, and Tally ponders if the future is written in stone.

episodes.name: Book Club
episodes.overview: Tally reunites with her mother and finds a reason to keep fighting. Abigail and Adil return to Fort Salem to find their home has changed. Scylla and Edwin work together in attempt to reach Raelle. Anacostia and Sterling plot an escape.

episodes.name: She Returns
episodes.overview: Allies converge to protect the Cession from occupation. The Camarilla march on the Cession, ready to invade under the guise of smoking out our fugitives. Tally and Scylla team up while Abigail, Adil and Anacostia seek out President Wade.

episodes.name: Petra's Favorite Pen
episodes.overview: The Unit races to rescue a captured ally. Alder and Tally journey to retrieve the penultimate piece of the First Song. Fort Salem finds itself under Camarilla’s control.

episodes.name: But I Don't Even Have A Dress...
episodes.overview: Abigail, Raelle, Tally, and Scylla speak out against the Camarilla during a trial leveled against all witches – will it be enough to turn the tide? Even in the darkest moments, joy is found.

episodes.name: Revolution (2)
episodes.overview: In a climactic battle, the Unit and its allies team up to fight the Camarilla. Alder races across the world to find the final piece of the First Song.

titles.overview: Carmy, a young fine-dining chef, comes home to Chicago to run his family sandwich shop. As he fights to transform the shop and himself, he works alongside a rough-around-the-edges crew that ultimately reveal themselves as his chosen family.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: In season two, Carmen 'Carmy' Berzatto, Sydney Adamu and Richard 'Richie' Jerimovich work to transform their grimy sandwich joint into a next-level spot. As they strip the restaurant down to its bones, the crew undertakes transformational journeys of their own, each forced to confront the past and reckon with who they want to be in the future.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: In season three, Carmen 'Carmy' Berzatto, Sydney Adamu, and Richard 'Richie' Jerimovich do what it takes to elevate The Bear, their beef stand turned fine dining establishment, to the highest level, all while doing their best just to stay in business. Our chefs have learned that every second counts, but this season we'll find out if they have what it takes to make it to tomorrow.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Season four finds Carmen "Carmy" Berzatto, Sydney Adamu and Richard "Richie" Jerimovich pushing forward, determined not only to survive, but also to take The Bear to the next level. With new challenges around every corner, the team must adapt, adjust and overcome. This season, the pursuit of excellence isn't just about getting better - it's about deciding what's worth holding on to.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: The fifth and final season picks up the morning after Sydney, Richie and Natalie 'Sugar' discover that Carmy has quit the food industry, leaving the restaurant to them. With no money, the threat of a sale and a torrential storm in their way, the new partners must band together with the rest of the team to achieve one last service, hoping they'll finally earn a Michelin star. Ultimately, they learn that what makes a restaurant "perfect" might not be the food, but the people.

titles.overview: In Japan in the year 1600, at the dawn of a century-defining civil war, Lord Yoshii Toranaga is fighting for his life as his enemies on the Council of Regents unite against him, when a mysterious European ship is found marooned in a nearby fishing village.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: In Japan in the year 1600, at the dawn of a century-defining civil war, Lord Yoshii Toranaga is fighting for his life as his enemies on the Council of Regents unite against him, when a mysterious European ship is found marooned in a nearby fishing village.

episodes.name: Anjin
episodes.overview: Destinies converge in Japan after a barbarian ship washes ashore in a poor fishing village. Meanwhile, in Osaka, Lord Toranaga finds himself outplayed by his enemies.

episodes.name: Servants of Two Masters
episodes.overview: Blackthorne's arrival in Osaka stirs up a hornet's nest of rivalries. Mariko is trapped between her cause and her faith when she must translate for the barbarian in Lord Toranaga's custody.

episodes.name: Tomorrow Is Tomorrow
episodes.overview: After Blackthorne survives a brazen assassination attempt, Toranaga realizes he must ferry his allies out of Osaka or risk certain defeat.

episodes.name: The Eightfold Fence
episodes.overview: Blackthorne and Mariko test their new alliance as they train Toranaga's gun regiment for war. Yabushige must navigate his past promises to Ishido when an old friend comes to the village.

episodes.name: Broken to the Fist
episodes.overview: Blackthorne and Mariko struggle to contain the secret that could get them both killed. Yabushige searches for the spy who has betrayed his intentions to Lord Toranaga.

episodes.name: Ladies of the Willow World
episodes.overview: Lady Ochiba returns to Osaka in order to accelerate the Regents' campaign against Toranaga. In Ajiro, Toranaga tests Mariko's loyalty to his cause.

episodes.name: A Stick of Time
episodes.overview: Outplayed by new alliances in Osaka, Toranaga is forced to carve out a new deal with a long lost family member.

episodes.name: The Abyss of Life
episodes.overview: Toranaga's defeated clan moves to Edo and awaits their fate. Blackthorne must decide who he fights for - the lord who has turned his back on him, or the ambition that brought him to Japan in the first place.

episodes.name: Crimson Sky
episodes.overview: Mariko arrives in Osaka for the fight of her life. Blackthorne and Yabushige scramble to save their own heads as their options dwindle.

episodes.name: A Dream of a Dream
episodes.overview: In the wake of a tragic death, Blackthorne finally considers the true nature of Toranaga's plan.

titles.overview: Twenty years after modern civilization has been destroyed, Joel, a hardened survivor, is hired to smuggle Ellie, a 14-year-old girl, out of an oppressive quarantine zone. What starts as a small job soon becomes a brutal, heartbreaking journey, as they both must traverse the United States and depend on each other for survival.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: After a global pandemic destroys civilization, a hardened survivor takes charge of a 14-year-old girl who may be humanity's last hope.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: After five years of peace following the events of the first season, Joel and Ellie's collective past catches up to them, drawing them into conflict with each other and a world even more dangerous and unpredictable than the one they left behind.

episodes.name: When You're Lost in the Darkness
episodes.overview: 2003. As a parasitic fungal outbreak begins to ravage the country and the world, Joel Miller attempts to escape the escalating chaos with his daughter and brother. Twenty years later, a now hardened Joel and his partner Tess fight to survive under a totalitarian regime, while the insurgent Fireflies harbor a teenage girl with a unique gift.

episodes.name: Infected
episodes.overview: In 2003, an Indonesian scientist makes a devastating discovery. In 2023, now outside of the quarantine zone, Joel and Tess clash over Ellie's fate as they navigate a long-abandoned Boston overrun with Infected.

episodes.name: Long, Long Time
episodes.overview: Doomsday prepper Bill prepares to ride out the apocalypse alone...until a mysterious stranger upends his plans. Years later, Joel and Ellie seek Bill's guidance – and find themselves at a crossroads.

episodes.name: Please Hold to My Hand
episodes.overview: After a harrowing trek across a desolate United States, Joel and Ellie find themselves navigating a dangerous Kansas City on foot. Later, rebel leader Kathleen instigates a manhunt – one that pits her violent civilian militia against the world's best hope.

episodes.name: Endure and Survive
episodes.overview: On the streets of a newly free Kansas City, Henry fights to protect his brother Sam from rebel soldiers who will stop at nothing to appease their ruthless leader. As her manhunt continues, Kathleen doubles down on her quest for revenge, while Ellie forms a meaningful friendship.

episodes.name: Kin
episodes.overview: After months of traveling, Joel and Ellie receive a grave warning about what lies ahead. Later, Ellie learns more about Joel's past – while Joel tries his best to forget.

episodes.name: Left Behind
episodes.overview: As Joel fights to survive, Ellie’s struggle to save him stirs memories of her life in a FEDRA orphanage. Weeks before meeting Joel, Ellie recalls joining her best friend Riley for a night to remember… one that will change the course of both of their lives – and the fate of the world – forever.

episodes.name: When We Are in Need
episodes.overview: After crossing paths with a vengeful group of survivors, Ellie's fighting spirit draws unwanted attention from its leader. Still battling for his life, a weakened Joel faces off with a hunting party out for blood.

episodes.name: Look for the Light
episodes.overview: After being pursued by Infected, a pregnant Anna places her trust in a lifelong friend. Years later, Ellie is forced to grapple with the emotional toll of her journey, while Joel faces a devastating decision of his own.

episodes.name: Future Days
episodes.overview: Five years after the events in Salt Lake City, a now 19-year-old Ellie makes a discovery while on patrol with her best friend Dina. Back in Jackson Hole, Joel seeks help to mend his relationship with Ellie.

episodes.name: Through the Valley
episodes.overview: As a storm brews in the mountains, the people of Jackson Hole prepare for the worst amid increased sightings of Infected. Meanwhile, Abby weighs her options.

episodes.name: The Path
episodes.overview: After Dina shares crucial information, Ellie prepares to petition the town council, even while she struggles with her deep emotional scars. On the outskirts of Seattle, a religious sect attempts to flee a war – raising questions on what lies ahead.

episodes.name: Day One
episodes.overview: In 2018, Seattle FEDRA confronts an unexpected foe. Ten years later, Ellie and Dina find themselves in the middle of a bloody battle between the zealous Seraphites and a ruthless militia.

episodes.name: Feel Her Love
episodes.overview: The WLF makes a dangerous discovery... at a great cost. Later, Ellie must decide whether to continue with her plan – and risk putting Dina in danger – or give up on her quest for justice.

episodes.name: The Price
episodes.overview: Joel surprises Ellie for her birthday. Years later, Ellie prepares to confront Joel about her past.

episodes.name: Convergence
episodes.overview: As the Wolves and the Scars prepare for a battle that could potentially end their longstanding feud, Ellie's search draws her away from her friends and toward a devastating confrontation.

titles.overview: Follow a dysfunctional team of MI5 agents—and their obnoxious boss, the notorious Jackson Lamb—as they navigate the espionage world's smoke and mirrors to defend England from sinister forces.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: When a young man is kidnapped and threatened with beheading, the slow horses find themselves unexpectedly embroiled in a dangerous case that forces them to prove their worth.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Long-buried Cold War secrets emerge which threaten to bring carnage to the streets of London. When a liaison with Russian villains takes a fatal turn, our hapless heroes must overcome their individual failings and raise their spy game in a race to prevent a catastrophic incident.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: A romantic liaison in Istanbul threatens to expose a buried MI5 secret in London. When Jackson Lamb and his team of misfits are dragged into the fight, they find themselves caught in a conspiracy that threatens the future not just of Slough House but of MI5 itself.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: In season 4, a bombing detonates personal secrets, rocking Slough House's already unstable foundations.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: In season five, everyone is suspicious when resident tech nerd Roddy Ho has a glamorous new girlfriend. When a series of increasingly bizarre events occur across the city, it falls to the Slow Horses to work out how everything is connected. After all, Lamb knows that in the world of espionage, the London Rules — cover your back — always apply.

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: In season six, the Slow Horses are on the run as Diana Taverner embroils them all in a fatally high-stakes game of retaliation and revenge.

titles.overview: The Targaryen dynasty is at the absolute apex of its power, with more than 15 dragons under their yoke. Most empires crumble from such heights. In the case of the Targaryens, their slow fall begins when King Viserys breaks with a century of tradition by naming his daughter Rhaenyra heir to the Iron Throne. But when Viserys later fathers a son, the court is shocked when Rhaenyra retains her status as his heir, and seeds of division sow friction across the realm.

episodes.name: The House That Dragons Built S3 E1
episodes.overview: Co-creator and showrunner Ryan Condal, EP and episode director Loni Peristere, and more share behind-the-scenes insights from the season 3 premiere. Cast and crew share what it was like to film the most complicated buck sequences yet, the elaborate combination of SFX and VFX that makes the Battle of the Gullet so visceral and say goodbye to a beloved character.

episodes.name: The House That Dragons Built S3 E2
episodes.overview: Co-creator and showrunner Ryan Condal, Emma D’Arcy (Rhaenyra Targaryen), Harry Collett (Jacaerys Velaryon) and more dive into Season 3’s meticulous production and design, detailing Aemond’s new battle armor crafted specifically to accommodate his missing eye, learning to operate the buck to simulate dragon riding, and the challenging yet rewarding experience of filming a beheading scene.

episodes.name: The House That Dragons Built S3 E3
episodes.overview: A new reign has begun. Co-creator and showrunner Ryan Condal, Emma D’Arcy (Queen Rhaenyra Targaryen), Clinton Liberty (Addam of Hull), and more give behind-the-scenes insight into Episode 3 of the new season. Cast and crew discuss the special lenses and filming techniques used to portray Rhaenyra’s point of view, how the prosthetics teams created realistically edible rat dishes, and the stylistic choices behind the newly-knighted dragonriders’ costumes.

episodes.name: The House That Dragons Built S3 E4
episodes.overview: No task is too big for this team. Co-creator and showrunner Ryan Condal, Tom Glynn-Carney (Aegon Targaryen), Benjamin Evan Ainsworth (Daeron Targaryen), and more, walk through the massive production behind Season 3, Episode 4. Cast and crew discuss the attention to detail that went into crafting a full-size prosthetic head for Aegon’s dragon, Sunfyre, introducing the idyllic town of Tumbleton in an authentic way, and reimagining the Eyrie's Moon Door from Game of Thrones.

episodes.name: The House That Dragons Built S3 E5
episodes.overview: This crew is up for any challenge. Co-creator and showrunner Ryan Condal, Emma D'Arcy (Queen Rhaenyra), Matt Smith (Daemon Targaryen), Fabien Frankel (Ser Criston Cole), James Norton (Lord Ormund Hightower), and more, break down the logistics behind producing this latest episode. They dive into the challenges of staying above ground while filming Cole’s army on a muddy bog, the trial and error involved in properly lighting a labyrinth, and the research required to create lifelike bowels for a macabre massacre.

episodes.name: The House That Dragons Built S3 E6
episodes.overview: It’s all in the details. Co-creator and showrunner Ryan Condal, Fabien Frankel (Ser Criston Cole), Matt Smith (Daemon Targaryen), Steve Toussaint (Lord Corlys Velaryon), and more go in-depth into the diligent planning and preparation that went into creating Season 3, Episode 6 of House of the Dragon. Cast and crew discuss the process of choreographing Ser Criston’s last battle and Gwayne’s epic fight sequence, constructing Flea Bottom in a way that captured the poverty of its community, and the on-set effects of Lord Corlys’s spirit-lifting sea shanty.

episodes.name: The House That Dragons Built S3 E7
episodes.overview: Producing House of the Dragon requires pulling off the impossible. Co-creator and showrunner Ryan Condal, Emma D’Arcy (Rhaenyra Targaryen), Matt Smith (Daemon Targaryen), Tom Glynn-Carney (Aegon Targaryen), and more go in-depth into the massive scale and fiery effects that went into creating Season 3, Episode 7. Cast and crew discuss the elaborate CGI and on-the-ground production needed to film an epic dragon altercation, the meticulous planning behind setting twenty-three stuntmen on fire, and the unwavering dedication Tom put into portraying Aegon’s most powerful on-screen moment.

episodes.name: The House That Dragons Built S3 E8
Inside S3 E1
episodes.overview: Co-creator and showrunner Ryan Condal, along with episode director Loni Peristere, and the cast discuss how the first episode of Season 3 unravels in surprising and catastrophic ways. Aegon (Tom Glynn-Carney) is fleeing in the shadows, Alicent (Olivia Cooke) must face the consequences of her bargain with Rhaenyra (Emma D’Arcy), and in the Battle of the Gullet, Rhaenyra suffers another unfathomable loss, as war rages across sea and sky.

episodes.name: Inside S3 E2
episodes.overview: Co-creator and showrunner Ryan Condal, along with episode director Loni Peristere, and the cast discuss how the first episode of Season 3 unravels in surprising and catastrophic ways. Aegon (Tom Glynn-Carney) is fleeing in the shadows, Alicent (Olivia Cooke) must face the consequences of her bargain with Rhaenyra (Emma D’Arcy), and in the Battle of the Gullet, Rhaenyra suffers another unfathomable loss, as war rages across sea and sky.

episodes.name: Inside S3 E3
episodes.overview: Rhaenyra’s reign begins. Co-creator and showrunner Ryan Condal, Emma D’Arcy (Queen Rhaenyra Targaryen), Steve Toussaint (Lord Corlys Velaryon), James Norton (Lord Ormund Hightower), and more break down season 3, episode 3 of House of the Dragon. They discuss Rhaenyra’s trying first few days as queen, her shifting power dynamics with Alicent, and her revelation of Ormund’s shocking deceit.

episodes.name: Inside S3 E4
episodes.overview: House of the Dragon co-creator and showrunner Ryan Condal, Emma D’Arcy (Rhaenyra Targaryen), Olivia Cooke (Alicent Hightower), Matt Smith (Daemon Targaryen), Fabien Frankel (Criston Cole), and James Norton (Ormund Hightower) dive in-depth into Season 3, Episode 4 of #HOTD. They discuss Lord Ormund’s strategic occupation of Tumbleton and its impact on Rhaenyra, Ser Criston’s feelings of betrayal, and Daemon’s conflicting family encounter.

episodes.name: Inside S3 E5
episodes.overview: Tensions rise and truths are revealed. House of the Dragon co-creator and showrunner Ryan Condal, Emma D’Arcy (Rhaenyra Targaryen), Fabien Frankel (Ser Criston Cole), Olivia Cooke (Alicent Hightower), Matt Smith (Daemon Targaryen), and Ewan Mitchell (Aemond Targaryen) break down Season 3, Episode 5 of #HOTD. They discuss Aegon’s renewed confidence and violent revenge, Alicent’s and Mysaria’s striking similarities, and Lord Ormund’s ruthless plan to return the Iron Throne to its rightful heir.

episodes.name: Inside S3 E6
episodes.overview: The longing for power lies with many. House of the Dragon co-creator and showrunner Ryan Condal, Emma D’Arcy (Rhaenyra Targaryen), Matt Smith (Daemon Targaryen), Fabien Frankel (Ser Criston Cole) and James Norton (Lord Ormund Hightower) break down Season 3, Episode 6 of #HOTD. They discuss Daemon’s and Rhaenyra’s conflicting approaches to war, Aemond’s and Alys’s potentially powerful partnership, and Cole's shocking, yet inevitable final moment on the battlefield.

episodes.name: Inside S3 E7
episodes.overview: Secrets and lies come to light. House of the Dragon co-creator and showrunner Ryan Condal, Emma D’Arcy (Rhaenyra Targaryen), Matt Smith (Daemon Targaryen), James Norton (Lord Ormund Hightower), Ewan Mitchell (Aemond Targaryen), and Steve Toussaint (Lord Corlys Velaryon) break down Season 3, Episode 7 of #HOTD. They discuss Daemon’s struggle to balance his loyalties, Alicent’s ill-intentioned reunion with Aemond in Harrenhal, and Aegon’s redemption-turned-rebirth.

episodes.name: Inside S3 E8
episodes.overview: No one emerges unscathed. House of the Dragon co-creator and showrunner Ryan Condal, Emma D’Arcy (Rhaenyra Targaryen), Matt Smith (Daemon Targaryen), James Norton (Lord Ormund Hightower), Ewan Mitchell (Aemond Targaryen), and Olivia Cooke (Alicent Hightower) explain their character arcs and the evolution of war in the #HOTD Season 3 finale. They dive into Ulf’s impact on the war between the factions, Helaena’s devastating decision, and Rhaenyra’s season-long transformation as a ruler.

episodes.name: The Heirs of the Dragon
episodes.overview: Viserys hosts a tournament to celebrate the birth of his second child. Rhaenyra welcomes her uncle Daemon back to the Red Keep.

episodes.name: The Rogue Prince
episodes.overview: Princess Rhaenyra dives deep into the prophecies about House Targaryen while confronting a realm that resists the idea of a woman on the Iron Throne, and Prince Daemon, embittered over being passed over as the heir to Westeros, prepares to go to war.

episodes.name: Second of His Name
episodes.overview: Daemon and the Sea Snake battle the Crabfeeder. The realm celebrates Aegon's second nameday. Rhaenyra faces the prospect of marriage.

episodes.name: King of the Narrow Sea
episodes.overview: Daemon returns to court after the successful completion of the battle. Princess Rhaenyra must deal with potential suitors in order to keep her line of succession.

episodes.name: We Light the Way
episodes.overview: Daemon visits his wife in the Vale. Viserys and Rhaenyra broker agreements with the Valeryons. Alicent seeks the truth about the princess.

episodes.name: The Princess and the Queen
episodes.overview: Ten years later. Rhaenyra navigates Alicent's continued speculation about her children, while Daemon and Laena weigh an offer in Pentos.

episodes.name: Driftmark
episodes.overview: As the families gather on Driftmark for a funeral, Viserys calls for an end to infighting and Alicent demands justice.

episodes.name: The Lord of the Tides
episodes.overview: Six years later. With the Driftmark succession suddenly critical, Rhaenyra attempts to strike a bargain with Rhaenys.

episodes.name: The Green Council
episodes.overview: While Alicent enlists Cole and Aemond to track down Aegon, Otto gathers the great houses of Westeros to affirm their allegiance.

episodes.name: The Black Queen
episodes.overview: Mourning a tragic death, Rhaenyra tries to hold the kingdom together and Daemon prepares for war.

episodes.name: A Son for a Son
episodes.overview: While Rhaenyra struggles to come to terms with her son's murder, in King's Landing, Alicent grows concerned that Aegon's Small Council may lead them to an all-out war. Larys suggests Aegon needs a new Hand, and Rhaenyra arrives at a fateful decision.

episodes.name: Rhaenyra the Cruel
episodes.overview: As Otto schemes to turn the public against her, Rhaenyra questions Daemon's loyalty. Meanwhile, Ser Criston Cole concocts a misguided plan for revenge.

episodes.name: The Burning Mill
episodes.overview: As ancient grudges resurface, Rhaenys suggests that Alicent may see reason while the men around her seek bloodshed. Ser Criston proposes a bold scheme. Daemon arrives at Harrenhal to raise an army for the Blacks.

episodes.name: The Red Dragon and the Gold
episodes.overview: In Rhaenyra's absence and with no word from Daemon at Harrenhal, Rhaenys tries to keep the peace on the Black Council as Cole mounts a campaign into the Crownlands. In King's Landing, Aemond continues to undermine Aegon's fragile hold on authority.

episodes.name: Regent
episodes.overview: Amid whispers of bad omens, the Greens consider how to fill a void on Aegon's Council, Jacaerys sets out on a rogue mission to strike a deal, and Daemon enlists Lord Willem Blackwood to help persuade the Brackens to bend the knee.

episodes.name: Smallfolk
episodes.overview: With few options left, Rhaenyra summons a trusted knight for a risky venture and plots with Mysaria to catalyze the smallfolk. Meanwhile, Daemon's unease grows, and Aemond takes steps to reshape the Green Council.

episodes.name: The Red Sowing

titles.overview: A group of vigilantes known informally as “The Boys” set out to take down corrupt superheroes with no more than blue-collar grit and a willingness to fight dirty.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Superpowered individuals are recognized as superheroes, but in reality, abuse their powers for personal gain, information the public is kept unaware of.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: The even more intense, more insane season two finds The Boys on the run from the law, hunted by the Supes, and desperately trying to regroup and fight back against Vought. In hiding, Hughie, Mother’s Milk, Frenchie and Kimiko try to adjust to a new normal, with Butcher nowhere to be found. Meanwhile, Starlight must navigate her place in The Seven as Homelander sets his sights on taking complete control. His power is threatened with the addition of Stormfront, a social media-savvy new Supe, who has an agenda of her own. On top of that, the Supervillain threat takes center stage and makes waves as Vought seeks to capitalize on the nation’s paranoia.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: It’s been a year of calm. Homelander’s subdued. Butcher works for the government, supervised by Hughie of all people. But both men itch to turn this peace and quiet into blood and bone. So when The Boys learn of a mysterious Anti-Supe weapon, it sends them crashing into the Seven, starting a war, and chasing the legend of the first Superhero: Soldier Boy.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: The world is on the brink. Victoria Neuman is closer than ever to the Oval Office and under Homelander's muscly thumb as he consolidates his power. Butcher, with only months to live, has lost Becca's son, and his job as The Boys' leader. The rest of the team are fed up with his lies. With the stakes higher than ever, they must find a way to work together and save the world before it's too late.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: Homelander controls America through fascist terror, imprisoning dissenters in Freedom Camps. Butcher, Hughie, Annie and The Boys mount a desperate resistance against insurmountable odds to stop his tyrannical rule.

titles.overview: In a ruined and toxic future, thousands live in a giant silo deep underground. After its sheriff breaks a cardinal rule and residents die mysteriously, engineer Juliette starts to uncover shocking secrets and the truth about the silo.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: In a bleak dystopian future, humanity clings to survival deep underground within the confines of a colossal silo. Juliette, an engineer tasked with unraveling the mystery behind the death of a colleague, uncovers startling secrets that threaten the very fabric of their enclosed world.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Stranded outside her silo with a failing suit, Juliette Nichols races against time, stunned to find another silo nearby that could be her only hope for survival. Meanwhile, unrest brews inside her original silo as Bernard Holland rallies citizens to maintain order amid rising questions about their world. As Juliette faces unexpected dangers near the new silo, hidden truths about the silos’ origins and the world beyond begin to surface, deepening the mystery.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Season three reveals an origin story set centuries earlier, while continuing the saga of a dystopian society of 10,000 people living underground under mysterious circumstances. In the present, Juliette Nichols survives her forced "cleaning" but returns with memory loss as the silo recovers from rebellion and faces a dangerous new threat. Meanwhile, in the "Before Times," journalist Helen Drew and Congressman Daniel Keene uncover a conspiracy that pulls them into a chain of events with catastrophic, irreversible consequences.

titles.overview: Ted Lasso, an American football coach, moves to England when he's hired to manage a soccer team—despite having no experience. With cynical players and a doubtful town, will he get them to see the Ted Lasso Way?

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Slowly but surely, Ted makes England his new home. Throughout the season, the down-on-their-luck players cannot help but be charmed and inspired by Ted. Even team owner Rebecca Welton who initially hired Ted to tank the team’s chances and to annoy her cheating ex-husband, was moved by Ted’s boyish innocence, determination, and outrageous tea biscuits.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Season 2 will no doubt be a redemption story. While the team will face struggles, Ted’s illuminating, yet often frustrating kindness will encourage the team to move forward. As Ted believes, everything will work out the way it’s supposed to. Struggling to adjust to their lower league status, Ted focuses the team’s attention toward leaving behind their losing streak. Ted adjusts to his life without his now ex-wife Michelle and his young son, Henry, who have returned to the US. A psychologist named Sharon joins the team. The lovable Keeley Jones and newly retired Roy Kent continue dating. Roy is adjusting to his new life on the sidelines. As for Rebecca Welton starts dating again.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: In this third season, the newly-promoted AFC Richmond faces ridicule as media predictions widely peg them as last in the Premier League and Nate, now hailed as the "wonder kid," has gone to work for Rupert at West Ham United. In the wake of Nate's contentious departure from Richmond, Roy Kent steps up as assistant coach, alongside Beard. Meanwhile, while Ted deals with pressures at work, he continues to wrestle with his own personal issues back home, Rebecca is focused on defeating Rupert and Keeley navigates being the boss of her own PR agency. Things seem to be falling apart both on and off the pitch, but Team Lasso is set to give it their best shot anyway.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: In season four, Ted returns to Richmond, taking on his biggest challenge yet: coaching a second division women's football team. Throughout the course of the season, Ted and the team learn to leap before they look, taking chances they never thought they would.

episodes.name: Sunflowers
episodes.overview: A friendly match takes the team to Amsterdam, where one night out unlocks truths for many.

episodes.name: The Strings That Bind Us
episodes.overview: The Greyhounds try a new strategy that has everyone thinking outside the box. Sam prepares to host a VIP guest at Ola's.

episodes.name: We'll Never Have Paris
episodes.overview: While watching Henry, Ted fights the urge to spiral when Michelle and Dr. Jacob go on a romantic trip. An online leak has massive implications for Keeley.

episodes.name: La Locker Room Aux Folles
episodes.overview: Colin and Isaac's friendship is tested. Roy is asked to do a press conference.

episodes.name: International Break
episodes.overview: While some of the Greyhounds head home to play for their countries in international matches, Edwin Akufo brings a business proposal to Rebecca.

episodes.name: Mom City
episodes.overview: An unexpected guest has Ted on edge. When Richmond travel to Manchester for a big match, Roy and Keeley become concerned about Jamie.

episodes.name: So Long, Farewell
episodes.overview: AFC Richmond play their final game of the season.

episodes.name: Home
episodes.overview: A few years after Ted leaves Richmond, some familiar faces visit him in Kansas...or is it Missouri?

episodes.name: Curiouser and Curiouser!
episodes.overview: Ted returns to Richmond to meet the Lady Greyhounds, but not everyone is glad to see him.

episodes.name: Richmond's Got Talent
episodes.overview: Richmond's shareholders are unsure about a women's team. The coaches hold tryouts to fill out their roster.

episodes.name: Greyhounds' Day Off
episodes.overview: The coaches must figure out how to break up team cliques. Ted adjusts to life outside the locker room.

episodes.name: Riches of Embarrassment
episodes.overview: The ladies face off against Chelsea. Alice feels the pressure. Rebecca navigates a complicated dynamic.

episodes.name: Don't Jump Around Much Anymore
episodes.overview: It's New Year's Eve! The team celebrates big. Rebecca, Roy, and Keeley ring it in with an old friend.

episodes.name: Yes & Baby
episodes.overview: Alice and Ted try stepping outside their comfort zones. Zelda helps with a new problem at Richmond.

episodes.name: Follow the Anger
episodes.overview: The Lady Greyhounds navigate a difficult setback. Roy and Keeley prepare for the Wall of Legends.

episodes.name: Mae Rides the Bus
episodes.overview: Morale is low, but the stakes have never been higher. Mae joins the team on the road. Keeley has news.

episodes.name: Being Alive
episodes.overview: Big changes in bunches.

titles.overview: When a young boy vanishes, a small town uncovers a mystery involving secret experiments, terrifying supernatural forces, and one strange little girl.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Strange things are afoot in Hawkins, Indiana, where a young boy's sudden disappearance unearths a young girl with otherworldly powers.

seasons.name: Stranger Things 2
seasons.overview: It's been nearly a year since Will's strange disappearance. But life's hardly back to normal in Hawkins. Not even close.

seasons.name: Stranger Things 3
seasons.overview: Budding romance. A brand-new mall. And rabid rats running toward danger. It's the summer of 1985 in Hawkins ... and one summer can change everything.

seasons.name: Stranger Things 4
seasons.overview: Darkness returns to Hawkins just in time for spring break, igniting fresh terror, disturbing memories — and an ominous new threat.

seasons.name: Stranger Things 5
seasons.overview: The fall of 1987. Hawkins is scarred by rifts. Vecna has vanished and the government has placed the town under military quarantine, forcing Eleven back into hiding. To end this nightmare, they'll need everyone together, one last time.

episodes.name: Chapter One: The Vanishing of Will Byers
episodes.overview: On his way home from a friend's house, young Will sees something terrifying. Nearby, a sinister secret lurks in the depths of a government lab.

episodes.name: Chapter Two: The Weirdo on Maple Street
episodes.overview: Lucas, Mike and Dustin try to talk to the girl they found in the woods. Hopper questions an anxious Joyce about an unsettling phone call.

episodes.name: Chapter Three: Holly, Jolly
episodes.overview: An increasingly concerned Nancy looks for Barb and finds out what Jonathan's been up to. Joyce is convinced Will is trying to talk to her.

episodes.name: Chapter Four: The Body
episodes.overview: Refusing to believe Will is dead, Joyce tries to connect with her son. The boys give Eleven a makeover. Nancy and Jonathan form an unlikely alliance.

episodes.name: Chapter Five: The Flea and the Acrobat
episodes.overview: Hopper breaks into the lab while Nancy and Jonathan confront the force that took Will. The boys ask Mr. Clarke how to travel to another dimension.

episodes.name: Chapter Six: The Monster
episodes.overview: A frantic Jonathan looks for Nancy in the darkness, but Steve's looking for her, too. Hopper and Joyce uncover the truth about the lab's experiments.

episodes.name: Chapter Seven: The Bathtub
episodes.overview: Eleven struggles to reach Will, while Lucas warns that "the bad men are coming." Nancy and Jonathan show the police what Jonathan caught on camera.

episodes.name: Chapter Eight: The Upside Down
episodes.overview: Dr. Brenner holds Hopper and Joyce for questioning while the boys wait with Eleven in the gym. Back at Will's, Nancy and Jonathan prepare for battle.

episodes.name: Chapter One: MADMAX
episodes.overview: As the town preps for Halloween, a high-scoring rival shakes things up at the arcade, and a skeptical Hopper inspects a field of rotting pumpkins.

episodes.name: Chapter Two: Trick or Treat, Freak
episodes.overview: After Will sees something terrible on trick-or-treat night, Mike wonders whether Eleven's still out there. Nancy wrestles with the truth about Barb.

episodes.name: Chapter Three: The Pollywog
episodes.overview: Dustin adopts a strange new pet, and Eleven grows increasingly impatient. A well-meaning Bob urges Will to stand up to his fears.

episodes.name: Chapter Four: Will the Wise
episodes.overview: An ailing Will opens up to Joyce -- with disturbing results. While Hopper digs for the truth, Eleven unearths a surprising discovery.

episodes.name: Chapter Five: Dig Dug
episodes.overview: Nancy and Jonathan swap conspiracy theories with a new ally as Eleven searches for someone from her past. “Bob the Brain” tackles a difficult problem.

episodes.name: Chapter Six: The Spy
episodes.overview: Will's connection to a shadowy evil grows stronger, but no one's quite sure how to stop it. Elsewhere, Dustin and Steve forge an unlikely bond.

episodes.name: Chapter Seven: The Lost Sister
episodes.overview: Psychic visions draw Eleven to a band of violent outcasts and an angry girl with a shadowy past.

episodes.name: Chapter Eight: The Mind Flayer
episodes.overview: An unlikely hero steps forward when a deadly development puts the Hawkins Lab on lockdown, trapping Will and several others inside.

episodes.name: Chapter Nine: The Gate
episodes.overview: Eleven makes plans to finish what she started while the survivors turn up the heat on the monstrous force that's holding Will hostage.

episodes.name: Chapter One: Suzie, Do You Copy?
episodes.overview: Summer brings new jobs and budding romance. But the mood shifts when Dustin's radio picks up a Russian broadcast, and Will senses something is wrong.

episodes.name: Chapter Two: The Mall Rats
episodes.overview: Nancy and Jonathan follow a lead, Steve and Robin sign on to a secret mission, and Max and Eleven go shopping. A rattled Billy has troubling visions.

episodes.name: Chapter Three: The Case of the Missing Lifeguard
episodes.overview: With El and Max looking for Billy, Will declares a day without girls. Steve and Dustin go on a stakeout, and Joyce and Hopper return to Hawkins Lab.

episodes.name: Chapter Four: The Sauna Test
episodes.overview: A code red brings the gang back together to face a frighteningly familiar evil. Karen urges Nancy to keep digging, and Robin finds a useful map.

episodes.name: Chapter Five: The Flayed
episodes.overview: Strange surprises lurk inside an old farmhouse and deep beneath the Starcourt Mall. Meanwhile, the Mind Flayer is gathering strength.

episodes.name: Chapter Six: E Pluribus Unum
episodes.overview: Dr. Alexei reveals what the Russians have been building, and Eleven sees where Billy has been. Dustin and Erica stage a daring rescue.

episodes.name: Chapter Seven: The Bite
episodes.overview: With time running out -- and an assassin close behind -- Hopper's crew races back to Hawkins, where El and the kids are preparing for war.

episodes.name: Chapter Eight: The Battle of Starcourt
episodes.overview: Terror reigns in the food court when the Mind Flayer comes to collect. But down below, in the dark, the future of the world is at stake.

episodes.name: Chapter One: The Hellfire Club
episodes.overview: El is bullied at school. Joyce opens a mysterious package. A scrappy player shakes up D&D night.

episodes.name: Chapter Two: Vecna's Curse
episodes.overview: A plane brings Mike to California — and a dead body brings Hawkins to a halt. Nancy goes looking for leads. A shaken Eddie tells the gang what he saw.

episodes.name: Chapter Three: The Monster and the Superhero
episodes.overview: Murray and Joyce fly to Alaska, and El faces serious consequences. Robin and Nancy dig up dirt on Hawkins' demons. Dr. Owens delivers sobering news.

episodes.name: Chapter Four: Dear Billy
episodes.overview: Max is in grave danger... and running out of time. A patient at Pennhurst asylum has visitors. Elsewhere, in Russia, Hopper is hard at work.

episodes.name: Chapter Five: The Nina Project
episodes.overview: Owens takes El to Nevada, where she's forced to confront her past, while the Hawkins kids comb a crumbling house for clues. Vecna claims another victim.

episodes.name: Chapter Six: The Dive
episodes.overview: Behind the Iron Curtain, a risky rescue mission gets underway. The California crew seeks help from a hacker. Steve takes one for the team.

episodes.name: Chapter Seven: The Massacre at Hawkins Lab
episodes.overview: As Hopper braces to battle a monster, Dustin dissects Vecna's motives — and decodes a message from beyond. El finds strength in a distant memory.

episodes.name: Chapter Eight: Papa
episodes.overview: Nancy has sobering visions, and El passes an important test. Back in Hawkins, the gang gathers supplies and prepares for battle.

episodes.name: Chapter Nine: The Piggyback
episodes.overview: With selfless hearts and a clash of metal, heroes fight from every corner of the battlefield to save Hawkins — and the world itself.

episodes.name: Chapter One: The Crawl
episodes.overview: November, 1987. The gang evades the military to scour the Upside Down for Vecna — but fails to notice a threat lurking closer to home.

episodes.name: Chapter Two: The Vanishing of...
episodes.overview: After a vicious attack at the Wheeler home, Mike and Nancy confront the cost of secrecy, while El and Hopper embark on a rescue mission.

episodes.name: Chapter Three: The Turnbow Trap
episodes.overview: Will gains unique insight into Vecna's next move, giving the crew an opportunity to set a trap. Holly explores her new surroundings.

episodes.name: Chapter Four: Sorcerer
episodes.overview: The military tightens its grip on the town. Mike, Lucas and Robin orchestrate a daring escape. El comes face-to-face with the enemy.

episodes.name: Chapter Five: Shock Jock
episodes.overview: The gang hatches an electrifying plan to reconnect Will to the hive mind. Tensions flare during a search of the Upside Down's Hawkins Lab.

episodes.name: Chapter Six: Escape from Camazotz
episodes.overview: As Holly and Max fight to escape Vecna's mind, El must find a way into Will's. Joyce wrestles with guilt. Jonathan and Nancy face a turning point.

episodes.name: Chapter Seven: The Bridge
episodes.overview: On the anniversary of Will's disappearance, the party reunites to prepare for a battle with world-altering implications.

episodes.name: Chapter Eight: The Rightside Up
episodes.overview: As Vecna prepares to destroy the world as we know it, the party must put everything on the line to defeat him once and for all.

titles.overview: Smart, sarcastic and a little dead inside, Wednesday Addams investigates twisted mysteries while making new friends — and foes — at Nevermore Academy.

episodes.name: Wednesday's Child Is Full of Woe
episodes.overview: When a deliciously wicked prank gets Wednesday expelled, her parents ship her off to Nevermore Academy, the boarding school where they fell in love.

episodes.name: Woe Is the Loneliest Number
episodes.overview: The sheriff questions Wednesday about the night's strange happenings. Later, Wednesday faces off against a fierce rival in the cutthroat Poe Cup race.

episodes.name: Friend or Woe
episodes.overview: Wednesday stumbles on a secret society. During Outreach Day, Nevermore's outcasts mingle with Jericho's normies in Pilgrim World. Fudge, anyone?

episodes.name: Woe What a Night
episodes.overview: Wednesday asks Xavier to the Rave'N dance, sparking Tyler's jealousy — but Thing's got something up his sleeve. Meanwhile, Eugene stakes out the cave.

episodes.name: You Reap What You Woe
episodes.overview: During Parents Weekend, Wednesday digs into her family's past — and accidentally gets her dad arrested. Enid feels the pressure to "wolf out."

episodes.name: Quid Pro Woe
episodes.overview: Wednesday's friends throw her a surprise birthday party. They mean well... but she'd much rather mark the miserable occasion by solving the murders.

episodes.name: If You Don't Woe Me by Now
episodes.overview: Kooky Uncle Fester pays a visit and shares his theory about the monster. Wednesday begrudgingly agrees to a date with Tyler at Crackstone's crypt.

episodes.name: A Murder of Woes
episodes.overview: Wednesday lands in trouble with Principal Weems, but that's just the start of her problems. To fight an ancient evil, she'll need all her friends’ help.

episodes.name: Here We Woe Again
episodes.overview: After a productive summer break, Wednesday returns to Nevermore as a grudging campus celebrity — and the target of a dangerous stalker.

episodes.name: The Devil You Woe
episodes.overview: Chaos reigns on campus as Nevermore celebrates its annual Prank Day. Wednesday confronts an old enemy and gains an unwanted ally.

episodes.name: Call of the Woe
episodes.overview: Stripped of both her ability and Goody's book, Wednesday is forced to do some old-fashioned detective work on a school camping trip.

episodes.name: If These Woes Could Talk
episodes.overview: It's an Addams family investigation as Fester and Thing commit themselves to Wednesday's case. Trying to conceal one secret, Bianca stumbles on another.

episodes.name: Hyde and Woe Seek
episodes.overview: With Tyler on the loose, Wednesday readies for a risky Día de los Muertos showdown. Slurp's growing hunger poses problems for Pugsley.

episodes.name: Woe Thyself
episodes.overview: An encounter with a spirit from Nevermore's past gives Wednesday and Enid a new perspective on one another — and puts one of their classmates in danger.

episodes.name: Woe Me the Money
episodes.overview: As the school gala looms, Wednesday digs up dirt on Dort, Enid tries not to wolf out and Morticia engages in a battle of wills with Grandmama.

episodes.name: This Means Woe
episodes.overview: When buried family secrets are unearthed, Wednesday must race against time to prevent a dark prophecy from being realized.

titles.overview: After the party of heroes defeated the Demon King, they restored peace to the land and returned to lives of solitude. Generations pass, and the elven mage Frieren comes face to face with humanity's mortality. She takes on a new apprentice and promises to fulfill old friends' dying wishes. Can an elven mind make peace with the nature of life and death? Frieren embarks on her quest to find out.

episodes.name: OO Magic Episode 1: The Magic of Saying What You Are Thinking
episodes.overview: Frieren, Heiter, and Eisen test the spell that causes the user to say whatever they are thinking on Himmel, who begins to wax-poetic about his looks aloud. The three of them agree that it would be unbearable to listen to it long term.

episodes.name: OO Magic Episode 2: The Magic of Removing Only Alcohol From Alcoholic Beverages
episodes.overview: After using the spell that removes just the alcohol from an alcoholic drink, Frieren, Himmel, and Eisen taste the drink and can't tell the difference. They then urge Heiter to try the drink, but he immediately guesses that the drink isn't alcoholic, to which the party all call him a Corrupt Priest.

episodes.name: OO Magic Episode 3: The Magic of Waking Up at a Certain Time in the Morning
episodes.overview: Fern is excited to try the spell because of Frieren's oversleeping habits. She sets the specified time to 6 AM. The next day, Frieren wakes up at the correct time, but the spell is unable to keep her from falling back asleep.

episodes.name: OO Magic Episode 4: The Magic That Makes Your Body Smell Good
episodes.overview: Frieren and Fern wonder what type of good smell the spell produces. They try it on Stark, and find that he smells like grilled meat. The two conclude that the smell is based on the user's definition of a good smell. Stark asks what's for dinner, and both Frieren and Fern exclaim that they want meat, scaring Stark.

episodes.name: OO Magic Special Episode: The Magic of Happiness at the Table
episodes.overview: Frieren's Party test the spell, which produces a bottle of Ajipon. They try the sauce with meat and find that it is delicious. Stark wonders if the sauce would taste good with dragon meat, and Frieren and Fern tell him to go defeat a dragon on his own so they can see.

episodes.name: OO Magic Episode 5: The Magic That Brings Good Luck
episodes.overview: Frieren's Party test the spell on Stark, who proceeds to have exceptional luck. The path they pick has no monsters and he wins a grand prize. Seeing this, Sein asks Frieren to cast the spell on him. He then goes gambling, but later returns with no clothes. Stark wonders if the spell didn't work, but Frieren says that Sein is just bad.

episodes.name: OO Magic Episode 6: The Magic That Removes Persistent Oil Stains
episodes.overview: Sein has the idea of using the spell for profit by charging people who need tough oil stains removed from their pots and pans. However, because they offer to clean the first pot or pan for free, everyone only brings one pot or pan, and it ends up being volunteer work for Frieren.

episodes.name: OO Magic Episode 7: The Magic of Being Able to Speak Extremely Fast and Without Hestitation
episodes.overview: Frieren and Heiter try the spell out on the taciturn Eisen. At first the spell doesn't seem to have worked, but when they ask him about a recent battle, both his speech and his movements increase in speed. Frieren and Heiter conclude that it's good for people to have their own manner of speech.

episodes.name: OO Magic Episode 8: The Magic to Understand a Fish's Feelings
episodes.overview: Frieren and Fern decide to test the spell on fish that Stark has caught while he gathers firewood. The fish speak pitifully and bemoan their family's bad luck, as their father was caught the day before. They wonder if they will be roasted or simmered. Frieren and Fern lose the appetite for fish and ask Stark to release them to his shock.

episodes.name: OO Magic Episode 9: The Magic That Brings Good Luck - Part 2
episodes.overview: Frieren's Party encounter three treasure chests. Fern cautions that at least one of them must be a mimic, so Stark suggests using the magic that brings good luck. The first chest contains gold and treasure, and the second chest contains a rare grimoire. To their dismay, Frieren insists on opening the third chest, which is a mimic. She gets caught and yells that it is dark and scary inside, and Fern wonders if Frieren did this on purpose.

episodes.name: OO Magic Episode 10: The Magic of Ending One's Sentences in a Weird Way
episodes.overview: Frieren tests a spell on the Hero Party that makes their sentences end strangely. They decide to have a contest - use the spell on everyone, and whoever laughs first must use the spell for a week. Himmel's sentences end in "nyan," Frieren's ends in "zoi," and Heiter's ends in "po." All three are able to hold in their laughter, but when Eisen speaks, his sentences end in "datcha" and the rest of the party are sent flying.

episodes.name: Frieren: Journey's Memory Special Video
episodes.overview: A special video depicting the memories of Frieren's journey.

episodes.name: OO Magic Episode 11: The Magic That Makes Clothes Clean and Spotless
episodes.overview: After praising Fern for receiving the legendary spell that makes clothes clean and spotless from Serie, Frieren accidentally spills food on herself. Fern uses the spell to remove the stain, which amazes Frieren and Stark. Stark dirties his clothes in the forest and tells Fern to perform the spell on him, but much to his dismay, Fern refuses to use the magic on someone that purposefully gets dirty.

episodes.name: Great Thanksgiving - The Path to Understand People's Hearts
episodes.overview: Based on the survey of "scenes you want to see again" conducted on the official website, we look back on the protagonist Frieren's journey to understand the human heart, with a focus on three themes: "famous lines" that resonate with the heart, intense "battle scenes", and "humorous scenes" that make you laugh unintentionally.

episodes.name: OO Magic Episode 12: Magic to Increase Height
episodes.overview: After feeling patronised by Heiter patting her on the head, Frieren recalls finding a tome with a spell to make people grow taller.

episodes.name: OO Magic Episode 13: The Magic to Have a Full Stomach
episodes.overview: Stark complains of hunger and Frieren uses a spell to make him feel full, despite her disapproval.

episodes.name: OO Magic Episode 14: The Magic That Can Cut Almost Anything
episodes.overview: Übel and Land test Reelseiden's cooking use outside of combat, preparing lunch for the kitchen owner and Land. Despite her culinary prowess cutting the ingredients to perfection, she fails miserably at actually cooking. Still, she urges the owner and Land to eat the food.

episodes.name: OO Magic Episode 15: The Magic to Move at High Speeds
episodes.overview: Denken and Laufen visit Richter's magic shop for no specific reason, and Laufen showcases her specialty magic, Erfasen (high-speed magic).

episodes.name: OO Magic Episode 16: The Magic to Make Your Surroundings Cool
episodes.overview: Frieren, Fern, and Stark are journeying through the warm and sticky climate of the Northern Lands. Frieren shares a rather insignificant spell she has acquired, known as "Magic to Make the Area Around Your Body Cool." She employs this spell to remain comfortably cool, although its effect is very limited, creating a "cool zone" that extends only a few inches from her skin.

episodes.name: OO Magic Episode 17: The Magic to Seal Special Techniques
episodes.overview: During their decade-long journey, the Hero Party comes across a challenge or a lesser enemy. Frieren boldly proposes to utilize a unique spell she discovered that "restricts specialized techniques." True to Frieren's assortment of unusual spells, the incantation is remarkably ineffective. It only restricts actions that are very particular or bizarre, making it of little value in genuine battle situations.

episodes.name: OO Magic Episode 18: The Magic to Restrain Those in View
episodes.overview: The Northern Magic Corps captain Warrior-mage, Wirbel demonstrates his signature binding spell "Sorganeil" on Frieren, Fern, and Stark.

episodes.name: OO Magic Episode 19: The Magic to Return to Childhood
episodes.overview: Frieren experiments with a spell designed to revert someone to their childhood self, specifically aiming to turn Himmel back to a time before he became a narcissist.

episodes.name: OO Magic Episode 20: The Magic to Swaps the Mind and Body
episodes.overview: Frieren, Fern, and Stark obtain a spell that swaps the hearts and bodies of two targets as a reward for a quest.

episodes.name: OO Magic Episode 21: The Magic of Laundry
episodes.overview: Following the events of the First-Class Mage Exam, Fern is granted a single "privilege" (a spell of her choice) by the great mage Serie. While other mages typically ask for legendary combat spells or ancient lost knowledge, Fern requests a seemingly mundane spell: the ability to make clothes clean and spotless.

episodes.name: OO Magic Episode 22: The Magic of Saying What You Are Thinking - Part 2
episodes.overview: Fern uses Frieren's spell “The Magic That Makes You Say What You're Thinking” to peek into Methode's mind, but the result ends up shocking her.

episodes.name: OO Magic Episode USJ Special Edition: The Magic to Admiration
episodes.overview: 2026/5/30 (Fri) Universal Studios Japan collaboration starts

episodes.name: The Journey's End
episodes.overview: The world celebrates the Demon King's defeat at the hands of the Hero and his companions. Now that their great adventure is over, what will Frieren the mage do next?

episodes.name: It Didn't Have to Be Magic...
episodes.overview: Frieren instructs Fern in the use of magic while deciphering a grimoire for Heiter.

episodes.name: Killing Magic
episodes.overview: While retracing the path she took on her adventure with her former traveling companions, Frieren confronts an old enemy.

episodes.name: The Land Where Souls Rest
episodes.overview: Frieren and Fern pay a visit to Eisen, who requests their help in finding the notes of Flamme the Legendary Mage.

episodes.name: Phantoms of the Dead
episodes.overview: Frieren and Fern investigate ghost sightings at a village where people have started going missing.

episodes.name: The Hero of the Village
episodes.overview: Frieren and Fern enlist Stark's help to fight the solar dragon - but is he up to the task?

episodes.name: Like a Fairy Tale
episodes.overview: After reflecting on the transient nature of the past as it exists in people's collective memories, Frieren unexpectedly runs into a sworn enemy.

episodes.name: Frieren the Slayer
episodes.overview: As tensions in Graf Granat's domain reach a breaking point, Fern and Stark find their own resolve - and Frieren resumes an old duty.

episodes.name: Aura the Guillotine
episodes.overview: While Fern and Stark make a temporary retreat with Graf Granat, Frieren's true foe awaits her outside the city.

episodes.name: A Powerful Mage
episodes.overview: Frieren's many years of training under her teacher Flamme are tested in her confrontation with Aura the Guillotine. Will Aura's scales find her wanting?

episodes.name: Winter in the Northern Lands
episodes.overview: Frieren and her companions continue their journey through the northern lands, but obstacles both natural and manmade still stand in their way.

episodes.name: A Real Hero
episodes.overview: Deep in the mountains of the northern lands, Frieren and her party arrive at the Village of the Sword, where they have another job to do.

episodes.name: Aversion to One's Own Kind
episodes.overview: While passing by a village in the woods of the northern lands, Frieren and party meet Sein, a gifted priest who is nonetheless corrupt enough to give even Heiter a run for his money. But what happened in his past?

episodes.name: Privilege of the Young
episodes.overview: The party arrives in a large and lively town with a bustling shopping district that Frieren once visited with Himmel, but something seems to have come up between Fern and Stark.

episodes.name: Smells Like Trouble
episodes.overview: When the party happens upon a town whose inhabitants are all mysteriously asleep, it's time for their newest traveling companion to prove his mettle.

episodes.name: Long-Lived Friends
episodes.overview: Frieren pays a visit to Old Man Voll, a long-lived friend of hers, with traveling companions in tow.

episodes.name: Take Care
episodes.overview: Now that Sein finally has a lead on the whereabouts of his long-lost friend, is it time for him and Frieren's party to part ways?

episodes.name: First-Class Mage Exam
episodes.overview: Frieren and party finally arrive in Äußerst, ready to undergo the first-class mage exam, and meet a number of colorful characters who are there to do the same.

episodes.name: Well-Laid Plans
episodes.overview: Frieren and her new teammates hatch a plan to capture a Stille - but are the other teams just going to stand by and let it happen?

episodes.name: Necessary Killing
episodes.overview: The first-class mage exam intensifies as fighting breaks out between the participants - and what's at stake might even be worth killing for.

episodes.name: The World of Magic
episodes.overview: Frieren, Kanne, and Lawine struggle with the 13th party over possession of the Stille, but there'll be more surprises in store before their battle, and the first test, reach their conclusion.

episodes.name: Future Enemies
episodes.overview: After the conclusion of the first test, the exam participants have some time to kill in town. What do mages get up to on their days off?

episodes.name: Conquering the Labyrinth
episodes.overview: The aspiring first-class mages now face their second test: conquering the Ruins of the King's Tomb. A simple task, or so the proctor claims, but there's a reason this particular dungeon remains unexplored.

episodes.name: Perfect Replicas
episodes.overview: Due to the Spiegel, a legendary monster that can create perfect replicas of others, the test-takers who would conquer the Ruins of the King's Tomb must first face the ultimate enemy: themselves.

episodes.name: A Fatal Vulnerability
episodes.overview: A perfect imitation of Frieren stands between the test-takers and victory, but Fern believes she knows how to win. Is it time for the student to surpass the master?

episodes.name: The Height of Magic
episodes.overview: To defeat Spiegel, Frieren and Fern fight against Frieren's replica, but have a tough time. Meanwhile, Denken, Lavine, and the others fight against the replicas, but the magic of Sense, a first-class mage and the exam's proctor, rages.

episodes.name: An Era of Humans
episodes.overview: With the second test behind them, only one remains - but first, Frieren and Fern need to settle an important matter in town. What awaits them in the third test?

episodes.name: It Would Be Embarrassing When We Met Again
episodes.overview: As the first-class mage exam concludes and the test-takers go their separate ways, farewell leads to departure - but the next stage of Frieren's journey has only just begun.

episodes.name: Shall We Go, Then?
episodes.overview: Frieren, Fern, and Stark leave the magic city of Äußerst behind and travel along a road in the northern lands.

episodes.name: The Hero of the South
episodes.overview: In a village in the northern lands, Frieren’s party are hired to polish a statue of a hero.

episodes.name: Somewhere She'd Like
episodes.overview: Frieren’s party dream of hot springs as they reach Etwas, but the village is abandoned.

episodes.name: Other People's Homes
episodes.overview: Stark only asked Fern out as a joke, but the two end up going on a date.

episodes.name: Logistics in the Northern Plateau
episodes.overview: Frieren is reunited with Fass the dwarf, who has been searching for the Boshaft liquor for over 200 years.

episodes.name: A Demon-Slaying Request
episodes.overview: A village on the Northern Plateau is wiped out, and the victims' distinctive wounds point to a certain demon.

episodes.name: The Divine Revolte
episodes.overview: Frieren, Fern, and Methode enter the woods to look for the four-armed Divine Revolte.

episodes.name: A Magnificent End
episodes.overview: The Divine Revolte appears at the village, while Frieren, Fern, and Methode battle Solide and Hemmung.

episodes.name: Himmel's Memoirs
episodes.overview: When Frieren's party cannot afford the fare to cross Lake Korridor, the captain proposes a trade.

episodes.name: A Beautiful Sight
episodes.overview: Hidden within the massive bridge spanning the Great Canyon Tor is a secret story of Himmel and Gehen.

titles.overview: On the front lines of the war, Tanya Degurechaff, blond hair, blue eyes, and porcelain white skin, commands her squad with lisping voice. Actually, she is one of Japan's most elite salary men, reborn as a little girl into a world of magical warfare after angering a mysterious being who calls himself God.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: With the establishment of the Salamander Kampfgruppe, the recently-promoted Lieutenant Colonel Tanya von Degurechaff's all-too-brief respite at the rear lines is over, and she's once again shipped to the front lines. This time, she's being once again stationed to the east, where she'll have to handle the Federation's seemingly endless manpower amid harsh weather conditions that wreak havoc on the Empire's war machine. Meanwhile, the gears of world war are still turning, and the other great powers are not happy about the imperial successes...

episodes.name: Youjo Shenki: Mini-Episode 00
episodes.overview: This mini-episode serves as a comedic introduction to Tanya’s character in the mini-series format.

episodes.name: Youjo Shenki: Mini-Episode 01
episodes.overview: Tanya, known for her ruthless battlefield tactics, is shown struggling with mundane office work — piles of paperwork, bureaucratic meetings, and the tedious side of military administration.

episodes.name: Youjo Shenki: Mini-Episode 02
episodes.overview: Tanya and Viktoriya are having a quiet conversation when Tanya suddenly spaces out (i.e. her expression changes, she becomes distant). Her grim expression and laughter terrify Viktoriya, who calls out to her but can’t immediately bring her back to her senses.

episodes.name: Youjo Shenki: Mini-Episode 03
episodes.overview: Tanya and Viktoriya are standing together in front of a nutcracker. Tanya is lost in thought, mentally complaining about a few things: being subject to “Being X,” problems with her superiors (like Doctor Schugel), military issues, etc.

episodes.name: Youjo Shenki: Mini-Episode 04
episodes.overview: Visha being unaware that her Captain was once a man.

episodes.name: Youjo Shenki: Mini-Episode 05
episodes.overview: Characters Rhiner, Viktoriya (“Visha”), Vooren, and Wilibald are gossiping about Tanya’s harsh training methods in the Imperial Army’s 203rd Air Mage Battalion.

episodes.name: Youjo Shenki: Mini-Episode 06
episodes.overview: Weiss expresses his doubts/concerns to Viktoriya about their war conduct, specifically that he (Weiss) was merely following the manual / orders as an Air Mage.

episodes.name: War Report
episodes.overview: Recap episode. Tanya reflects on how she went from Tokyo salaryman to 11-year old mage, and swears her revenge on Being X for putting her here.

episodes.name: Youjo Shenki: Mini-Episode 07
episodes.overview: Viktoriya (Visha) is talking with Neumann and Koenig, and remarks that she finds it odd that Tanya always carries a rifle with her, even though she supposedly doesn’t like to carry guns around.

episodes.name: Youjo Shenki: Mini-Episode 08
episodes.overview: Rhiner and Koenig visit him. Weiss expresses that he really wants chocolate to lift his spirits after the tiring fight.

episodes.name: Youjo Shenki: Mini-Episode 09
episodes.overview: Tanya asks Viktoriya if she can tell the difference between a normal and a rotten potato. Viktoriya responds that the only way she can tell is by taste. Tanya then explains the proper way to recognize a rotten potato and the aftereffects of consuming one.

episodes.name: Youjo Shenki: Mini-Episode 10
episodes.overview: The group is playing cards, and Vooren is on a losing streak, becoming increasingly frustrated. He suggests that betting alcohol instead of chocolate might make the game more serious.

episodes.name: Youjo Shenki: Mini-Episode 11
episodes.overview: Vooren Glanz, Wilibald Koenig, Rhiner Neumann and Matheus Johan Weiss are in a room while Neumann and Koenig complained to Weiss about his drunk attitude that scares women away, this caused them being not popular around women. Weiss will sexually harass women with words while he is drunk, which he claims it as only being compliments.Upon hearing this fact, the three was shocked especially Vooren. Weiss promised that he will not make the mistake again, then they went to get drinks.Unfortunately, Weiss got drunk and sexually harassed women. The other three stood aside, talking how they view alcohol as a prohibited item for Weiss then on. Suddenly, Viktoriya Ivanovna Serebryakov appeared being uncomfortable with two men harassing her. The four helped Visha and drove the men away. Visha being grateful to them as she does not know that Weiss harassed women sexually when he is drunk.

episodes.name: Youjo Shenki: Mini-Episode 12
episodes.overview: Viktoriya Ivanovna Serebryakov was writing on her diary, starting by introducing herself. Then, a brief introduction about Tanya Degurechaff and how Visha admires her. A flashback takes place of Tanya talking to her Battalion members, Matheus Johan Weiss, Viktoriya Ivanovna Serebryakov, Wilibald Koenig, Rhiner Neumann and Vooren Glanz.
