episodes.overview: Dead End discovers that Ruijerd will have to pay a fortune in fees to leave the Demon Continent. As they struggle to find a way around this unexpected roadblock, Rudeus receives another vision.

episodes.name: Missed Connections
episodes.overview: Roxy arrives on the Demon Continent to begin her search for Paul's missing family. Meanwhile, Rudeus strikes a deal with smugglers to transport Ruijerd across the ocean.

episodes.name: No Such Thing as a Free Lunch
episodes.overview: Rudeus finds himself imprisoned by the beast people in Doldia Village. Will Ruijerd and Eris arrive to clear his name before he loses patience and tries to fight his way to freedom?

episodes.name: Slow Life in the Doldia Village
episodes.overview: Dead End decide to wait out the rainy season in the Doldia village. Eris befriends the chieftain's granddaughter, but her fondness for Ghislaine leads to unexpected conflict.

episodes.name: Family Squabble
episodes.overview: Rudeus, Eris, and Ruijerd arrive in the Holy Country of Millis, where Rudeus's thoughts turn to home. When the three split up for a day off, a chance encounter in an alley leads Rudeus to a shocking reunion.

episodes.name: Reunion
episodes.overview: In the aftermath of their disastrous reunion, Paul and Rudeus reflect on their actions and look for a way forward.

episodes.name: Separate Journeys
episodes.overview: After setting out from Millishion, Rudeus, Eris, and Ruijerd board a ship back to the Central Continent. Meanwhile, Roxy arrives in Rikarisu, where she encounters some familiar faces.

episodes.name: Route Selection
episodes.overview: Dead End finally arrives in the Shirone Kingdom on the Central Continent. Rudeus is anxious for a reunion with Roxy, but an unexpected vision from the Man-God means he may be in for more than he bargained for.

episodes.name: The Birth of My Little Sister, the Maid
episodes.overview: Rudeus is in desperate straits, imprisoned in a magic-proof dungeon by a despotic prince. But just when all seems hopeless, an unexpected visitor appears with a strange request. Will Rudeus be able to talk his way out of this one?

episodes.name: Turning Point 2
episodes.overview: Rudeus, Eris, and Ruijerd are nearing the end of their journey, but a chance encounter in a snowy mountain pass threatens to put a premature end to their adventures.

episodes.name: Dreams and Reality
episodes.overview: Rudeus and Eris finally return to Fittoa, but sudden goodbyes and unpleasant news make their homecoming bittersweet.

episodes.name: Wake Up and Take a Step
episodes.overview: Rudeus sinks into depression following Eris's departure. As he struggles to get back on his feet, the many people he's met continue their own journeys.

episodes.name: The Brokenhearted Mage
episodes.overview: Rudeus journeys to the harsh northlands in search of his lost mother. Or at least, that's what he tells himself. The scars of his parting from Eris run deep, and getting back on his feet may not be so easy.

episodes.name: The Forest in the Dead of Night
episodes.overview: Rudeus doesn't want a new party, but he still grows closer to Counter Arrow as he settles into life as a northlands adventurer. When danger rears its head, he finds himself risking it all for his new friends.

episodes.name: Abrupt Approach
episodes.overview: Things seem to be looking up for Rudeus. And when Sara asks him on a date, he decides to forget his heartbreak and start a new romance. But putting the past behind him may be easier said than done.

episodes.name: Letter of Invitation
episodes.overview: After two years of adventuring with Soldat, Rudeus is no closer to finding his mother or curing his impotence. But the sudden arrival of a seductive elf and an unexpected offer could send his life off in a whole new direction.

episodes.name: Ranoa University of Magic
episodes.overview: Following the Man-God's advice, Rudeus enrolls in school. He reunites with an old friend and meets potential new enemies, but will he find what he seeks? And what does the future hold for him and the enigmatic "Silent Fitz"?

episodes.name: I Don't Want To Die
episodes.overview: Rudeus is settling into school life and growing better acquainted with the enigmatic Silent Fitz. But when his efforts to teach Zanoba hit a roadblock, his new friend proposes a drastic solution.

episodes.name: The Kidnapping and Confinement of Beast Girls
episodes.overview: When Rudeus discovers that two of his new schoolmates have destroyed one of his precious figures, he swears revenge. But while he may be able to trounce schoolgirls in a fight, figuring out what to do with them next won't be so easy.

episodes.name: The Fiancé of Despair
episodes.overview: Love is in the air. First, a smitten classmate seeks Rudeus's help to meet the girl of his dreams. Then the beast people's mating season puts Rudeus in an awkward position—one he'll have to fight his way out of.

episodes.name: The White Mask
episodes.overview: Investigating the mass teleportation leads Rudeus to seek out his most elusive classmate: the brilliant Silent Sevenstar. But when he calls at Silent's laboratory tower, he finds a familiar face that he didn't expect—and doesn't welcome.

episodes.name: These Feelings
episodes.overview: Rudeus settles into a new routine at the university. But as time passes, Silent Fitz is increasingly in his thoughts. What does he really feel for his enigmatic classmate? And how far will he pry into a friend's secrets to find out?

episodes.name: To You
episodes.overview: Ariel confronts Sylphiette with a choice: reveal herself to Rudeus or cut ties with him forever. Determined on one last push to jog Rudeus's memory, Sylphiette invites him on a forest expedition.

episodes.name: I Want to Tell You
episodes.overview: Sylphiette reveals herself and Rudeus admits his feelings, but even that isn't enough to cure what ails him. After their heart-to-heart, Sylphiette sets out to end his problem once and for all.

episodes.name: My Dream Home
episodes.overview: Newly cured and brimming with confidence, Rudeus resolves to marry Sylphie. Just one problem: he has no idea how marriage works in this world. And when friends tell him any newlywed needs a house, he winds up with a haunted mansion.

episodes.name: Wedding Reception
episodes.overview: The newlyweds have settled into their new home. Next, custom dictates they throw a party for everyone they know. Preparing to host a crowd won't be easy. And even if they pull it off, the big day has surprises in store.

episodes.name: Afar
episodes.overview: Rudeus receives a letter from Paul. The letter explains that Norn and Aisha, Rudeus's younger sisters, have been sent to join Rudeus. Meanwhile Nanahoshi continues her research into summoning magic for a way to return to her original world.

episodes.name: Norn and Aisha
episodes.overview: Rudeus's sisters arrive with an unexpected chaperone. After catching up with an old friend, Rudeus decides it's time to send the girls to school. But convincing Norn and Aisha turns out to be more trouble than he bargained for.

episodes.name: My Older Brother's Feelings
episodes.overview: Norn shuts herself in her dorm room and refuses to attend classes. Haunted by the specter of his past life, Rudeus sets out to solve his sister's problems, only to discover that he is the cause.

episodes.name: Turning Point 3
episodes.overview: Life is looking up for Rudeus. His sisters are settling in, and he has plenty of time for friends and family... until an announcement from Sylphie and an unexpected letter upend his idyllic school life.

episodes.name: Desert Journey
episodes.overview: With Nanahoshi's help, Rudeus gains a way to shorten his journey, but he and Elinalise will still need to hurry if they hope to return before Sylphie gives birth. Their first obstacle: the harsh desert of Begaritt and its monstrous denizens.

episodes.name: Into the Labyrinth
episodes.overview: Rudeus and Elinalise reach Rapan and soon reunite with Paul, only to learn that a deadly labyrinth has claimed both Zenith and Roxy. The fruits of Rudeus's studies offer a last, faint hope to reach his mother and his mentor in time.

episodes.name: Magic Circle to the Sixth Stratum
episodes.overview: With Roxy's rescue, the search for Zenith resumes in earnest. Rudeus reconnects with his mentor amid the perils of the labyrinth. But why does she seem a little more awkward around him than before?

episodes.name: Parents
episodes.overview: The rescue party reaches the heart of the Teleporter Labyrinth and confronts its guardian. But when the monster shrugs off Rudeus's magic, they realize they may have bitten off more than they can chew.

episodes.name: Let's Go Home
episodes.overview: Roxy makes a desperate move to pull Rudeus out of his depression. As the group journeys home, both of them must face their feelings and negotiate the consequences.

episodes.name: Succession
episodes.overview: Rudeus arrives home, frantic that something may have gone wrong in his absence. But the conversations waiting for him may become disasters in their own right. How can he introduce a new wife to a family still reeling from Paul's death?

episodes.name: Burn Bright, Mad Dog
episodes.overview: Ghislaine takes Eris to train under the Sword God, but Eris's brash attitude angers the other disciples.

episodes.name: Howl, Mad Dog
episodes.overview: Nina continues to eye Eris as a rival, but training with masters of other styles sparks new discoveries.

episodes.name: Life Back at Home
episodes.overview: Rudeus starts a new life with Roxy and Sylphiette, but not all his friends approve of his second marriage.

episodes.name: A King-Class Water Mage
episodes.overview: Fearful of losing more loved ones, Rudeus begs Roxy to teach him a more potent form of magic.

episodes.name: Celebrations
episodes.overview: Rudeus attends Cliff and Elinalise's wedding and goes shopping for his sisters' birthday presents.

episodes.name: Another Domestic Disaster?
episodes.overview: Rudeus accompanies Roxy on a bodyguard mission and runs into an unexpected face from his past.

episodes.name: Phase Four
episodes.overview: Following a successful summoning experiment, Nanahoshi offers Rudeus a reward.

episodes.name: The Flying Fortress
episodes.overview: Rudeus seeks an audience with the hero Perugius, hoping to find a cure for his mother's condition.

episodes.name: Lament
episodes.overview: Nanahoshi contracts an ancient disease. Seeing her lose hope, Rudeus races to find help.

episodes.name: An Audience with an Immortal Demon King
episodes.overview: Rudeus and friends locate Kishirika, only to be captured along with her by the guards of a warlike Demon King.

episodes.name: Turning Point 4
episodes.overview: Rudeus receives a puzzling message in his dreams. But before he can act on it, a strange visitor appears.

episodes.name: An End and a Beginning
episodes.overview: Rudeus's strange guest recounts his future and reveals the cause of all his misfortunes.

episodes.name: The Diary
episodes.overview: In a future that could have been, Rudeus crumbles under the weight of loss.

episodes.name: Resolve
episodes.overview: Having read one possible future, Rudeus takes action to avoid it and protect the people he loves.

titles.overview: Beryl Gardenant, a middle-aged swordsman running a dojo in the backwaters, lives a quiet life, until Allucia, former student and Commander of the Royal Order of Knights, appears! Beryl’s life is about to change dramatically! City life. Old students. New friends and formidable foes. It’s all too much. But after years of training, he has mad skills, and he’s been dubbed “the backwater swordmaster.”

seasons.name: From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman
From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman II

episodes.name: The Old Country Bumpkin Goes to the Capital
episodes.overview: Beryl Gardenant lives a quiet life running a dojo in the backwaters, until Allucia, his former student, appears with a new job for him – special instructor to the knights she commands! Beryl accepts the job, but Vice-Commander Henblitz doesn’t think he’s up to the task and challenges him to a duel.

episodes.name: The Old Country Bumpkin Is Astounded by a Wizard
episodes.overview: Allucia reminisces about her training with Beryl, and her resolve to have him instruct the knights hardens. While taking in the city sights with Curuni, Beryl meets up with Ficelle, another former student. She surprises him with her magic. But another wizard gives him even more of a surprise!

episodes.name: The Old Country Bumpkin Weathers a Fierce Attack
episodes.overview: Former student and top-ranking adventurer Surena enlists Beryl’s help to train new adventurers. At the Adventurer’s Guild, Beryl ends up in a duel with her to prove he has what it takes for the job. He isn’t really happy with the turn of events, but Surena seems to feel differently.

episodes.name: The Old Country Bumpkin Takes Flight With a Monster
episodes.overview: To protect the new adventurers, Beryl faces off against a dangerous monster. Unlike other opponents, it acts on instinct, and he’s drawn into a ferocious battle, unable to get a read on its moves. Later on, he faces an encounter that will turn his future upside down.

episodes.name: The Old Country Bumpkin Gets Enraged by the Bad Guys
episodes.overview: Beryl encounters a pickpocket. Seeing the despair in her eyes, he confronts her in an attempt to get her to open up, but it’s not as easy as he thinks. With the help of Allucia and Lucy, he strives to help her free herself from the clutches of shadowy forces and the evil that binds her.

episodes.name: The Old Country Bumpkin Faces the Dead
episodes.overview: Someone is controlling the lowlifes taking advantage of Mewi behind the scenes. Religion and international relations come to the forefront, and with no ties that might cause an international incident, Beryl is asked to flush out the mastermind. New sword in hand, Beryl battles for Mewi’s future.

episodes.name: The Old Country Bumpkin Learns the Challenges of Parenting
episodes.overview: Beryl and Mewi start living in the house Lucy gave Beryl. Although unsure, Beryl works on becoming a parent figure for Mewi. When they find out that the magic institute Mewi is enrolled at has a student dormitory, Beryl wonders whether it is best for her to live with him, or on campus.

episodes.name: The Old Country Bumpkin Gets Struck by a Lightning-Fast Sword
episodes.overview: When a delegation from a neighboring country arrives, Allucia asks Beryl to help guard the VIPs, and he can’t refuse. Beryl needs the right clothes for the job, so he and Allucia go shopping. It’s just like a date! The next day, Allucia approaches Beryl with an offer.

episodes.name: The Old Country Bumpkin Goes on His First Hunt in Ages
episodes.overview: Mewi needs a new bag for school, so Beryl goes shopping. But he quickly realizes just how expensive bags can be! A job offer from Surena provides a means to make some extra cash, and he jumps at the chance. But he soon realizes – this job is one even high-ranking adventurers have never completed!

episodes.name: The Old Country Bumpkin Guards a Princess
episodes.overview: The Vice Commander of the Holy Order of the Church of Sphene is Beryl’s former student, Rose, and he renews his ties with her. When the delegation arrives, Beryl is assigned to guard the two royal families as they tour the capital. But a shadow looms over what is supposed to be a joyous event.

episodes.name: The Old Country Bumpkin Throws Himself into a Deadly Fight
episodes.overview: Beryl helps protect the royal family from assassins, but the assassins all kill themselves, and any clues to the mastermind are lost. Lucy thinks a conflict between royalty and religion is at play. Despite Beryl wanting to cancel the tour of the capital to keep the prince safe, the plan goes ahead.

episodes.name: The Old Country Bumpkin Gets Praised as a Master Swordsman
episodes.overview: It was Rose behind the flood of assassins. Beryl confronts her in an effort to find where her true intentions lie. Rose tells him, and the two draw their swords against each other. What will the outcome be in this battle between master and student?

episodes.name: The Old Country Bumpkin Takes on a New Position
episodes.overview: A few months into his appointment as the Liberion Order's special instructor, Beryl Gardenant is settling into his new life in the capital. One day, he's visited by Lucy and Ficelle, who ask him to become a temporary instructor at the Magic Institute. Beryl joins the sword magic course where Mewi is enrolled, witnesses Ficelle's teaching methods, and finds himself facing off against her...

episodes.name: The Old Country Bumpkin Watches Them Grow
episodes.overview: Beryl wrestles with teaching Ficelle - who is a terrible teacher - how to actually teach. Mewi struggles to fit in with her fellow students, but a conversation with Cindy at lunch hints at that beginning to change. At a small party, Beryl views both Mewi and Ficelle's growth with satisfaction. And then an unexpected disturbance rocks the Magic Institute.

episodes.name: The Old Country Bumpkin Sees Himself in an Old Man
episodes.overview: Wolf-shaped shadows attack the teachers and magic is rendered useless on campus. Able to fight even without magic, Beryl and Ficelle force their way into the school in an effort to uncover the cause of the strange happenings. When shadow wolves appear in the cafeteria, Mewi and her classmates decide to confront them, despite their inexperience. Two battles unfold - so how will they end?

episodes.name: The Old Country Bumpkin Returns Home
episodes.overview: A letter addressed to Beryl arrives from Beaden. Sent by his father Mordea, it urges him to return to the village for an annual event unique to the village. With the Magic Institute on summer break, Beryl invites Mewi to accompany him and Henblitz. Then Curuni invites herself along. It's the first time Beryl's been home since his move to the city. The next day, an unexpected confrontation occurs.

episodes.name: The Old Country Bumpkin Lets Out a Roar
episodes.overview: Their mission to take down the saberboar begins. Curuni achieves her long-cherished goal of taking one down and realizes how much stronger she has become. Randrid makes full use of the skills he honed as an adventurer and puts his swordsmanship to good use. Impressed, Henblitz challenges him to a sparring match - which ignites something in the hearts of both Beryl and another swordsman.

episodes.name: The Old Country Bumpkin Faces Off Against His Father
episodes.overview: With the saberboar threat eliminated, Beaden holds its annual festival. The friendship between Henblitz and Randrid grows, while Adel and Edel fuss over Mewi. Beryl watches it all and reflects on his own feelings over the years. Then Mordea arrives and the two head for the dojo. Can Beryl overcome the giant wall that is his father?

episodes.name: The Old Country Bumpkin Gets an Invitation from Nobility
episodes.overview: A banquet is being held in the lands of the Margrave of Flumvelk, a region bordering Sphenedyardvania, and both Allucia and Beryl have been invited. The visit is also a chance to confirm the route the soon-to-be-wed Princess Salacia will take to her new home. Along the way, Beryl gives advice to a young knight. When he arrives at his destination, an unexpected reunion awaits him.

episodes.name: The Old Country Bumpkin Gets a Marriage Proposal
episodes.overview: Shueste, the sister of Beryl's former student Warren, relentlessly pursues Beryl - but for a good reason. Seeing this upsets Allucia, Warren explains both his and Shueste's motives, and encourages Allucia to make her own move. Beryl's actions at the banquet leave Shueste even more smitten. Having finished their assignment, Beryl and Allucia head home - but face an unforseen encounter on the way.

episodes.name: The Old Country Bumpkin Goes to the Holy City
episodes.overview: Back in the capital, Beryl struggles to shake his guilt over Vesper's grave injuries, while Surena tries to cheer him up. The day of Princess Salacia's wedding draws near, and Beryl joins the escort detail. After a short reunion with Shueste and with the threat of an attack by the Verdapis Mercenary Company looming, they reach Dilmahakha, the holy city of Sphenedyardvania. But who is watching him?

episodes.name: The Old Country Bumpkin Sees in the New Year
episodes.overview: Allucia and Gatoga visit Beryl at his lodgings in Dilmahakha, and Gatoga shows Beryl around the city. Once they're alone, Gatoga tells him what became of Rose. Back in Baltrain, Curuni and Ficelle put Mewi through special training, while Lucy and Ibroy meet in secret. The new year arrives, bringing Princess Salacia's wedding - and screams of terror ring out through the cathedral.

episodes.name: The Old Country Bumpkin Flies into a Rage
episodes.overview: The Verdapis Mercenary Company bursts into the cathedral. Beryl moves to stop them, but Ibroy yells, "They're on our side!" Forced into an uneasy alliance, Beryl and the others escort the prince and princess safely to the palace. Along the way, Beryl's rage clashes with Hanoy's pride as a mercenary. But an even greater crisis engulfs the Holy City - caused by none other than Pope Morris himself.

episodes.name: The Old Country Bumpkin Goes Home
episodes.overview: The masked White Maiden is revealed to be none other than Beryl's former student, Rose. Beryl and the White Maiden meet up with Allucia and Surena, who have successfully taken down the Chimera, and they head to back up the Verdapis Mercenary Company. There, they find Hanoy on the brink of defeat - and Pope Morris standing calmly before him. The final battle is about to begin.

titles.overview: After Hiraku dies of a serious illness, God brings him back to life, gives his health and youth back, and sends him to a fantasy world of his choice. In order to enjoy his second shot, God bestows upon him the almighty farming tool! Watch as Hiraku digs, chops, and ploughs in another world in this laidback farming fantasy!

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: During the final years of his life, Hiraku Machio remained confined to a hospital bed with a terminal illness until he finally passed away. Taking pity on the unfair life he lived, a god decides to reincarnate Hiraku in another world where he can live as he pleases. Wanting to try farming in this new life, he is bestowed with an all-in-one "Almighty Farming Tool" that can transform into any useful implement he wishes. Hiraku is then transported to a forest seemingly far from civilization. Here, he plans to build and farm everything from scratch—gradually developing the lifeless area into a thriving new society.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Great Tree Village has grown far beyond the small farm Hiraku once built in the wilderness. As waves of new immigrants arrive seeking refuge, the village faces the challenges of rapid expansion, from housing diverse races such as minotaurs, centaurs, and forest spirits to managing new farmland, resources, and community needs. Between welcoming newcomers, hosting tournaments and festivals, exploring hot springs, and strengthening ties with neighboring powers, Hiraku's dream of a peaceful rural life becomes busier—and livelier—than ever. As the village continues to evolve into a thriving multicultural settlement, every day brings new faces, new projects, and new adventures.

episodes.name: The Almighty Farming Tool
episodes.overview: Hikaru won’t waste his second chance at life; he will focus on what truly matters. And so, he builds a new home with his own two hands.

episodes.name: The First Villager
episodes.overview: As the weeks turn into months, Hiraku’s loneliness grows. He thought he desired a life of solitude, but his wish for companionship grows stronger by the day.

episodes.name: More and More New Roommates
episodes.overview: Hiraku and Lu begin their new life together, unaware of the visitors who will soon arrive at their household.

episodes.name: Waterways Make Life Feel Complete
episodes.overview: Now that they’ve secured a reliable water source, they can start a rice paddy and build a bathhouse.

episodes.name: Curry and Surviving the Winter
episodes.overview: With their homestead completed, they turn their focus to food preparation and just in time; Winter is coming.

episodes.name: This is a Village
episodes.overview: A surprise attack would have shattered their peaceful lives were it not for the almighty farming tool. As word spreads, their home blooms into a village.

episodes.name: A Hospitable Heart
episodes.overview: Hikaru realizes the importance of diplomacy when the demon lord and the dragons establish contact with the Great Tree Village.

episodes.name: The Researcher and The Two Princesses
episodes.overview: They say civilization started because of alcohol. In the Great Tree Village’s case, it instigates a misunderstanding between dragons.

episodes.name: The Merchant and The Dragon
episodes.overview: Hiraku’s offhand comment leads to a series of events that end with a merchant setting up a trade deal with The Great Tree Village.

episodes.name: Princess Yuri
episodes.overview: Spurred by her followers, the demon lord's daughter attempts to invade the Great Tree Village. "Attempts" being the keyword.

episodes.name: Everyday Life, and The Progenitor
episodes.overview: News of the impending birth thrills the villagers, but they aren’t the only ones interested in the good news.

episodes.name: Birth
episodes.overview: Hiraku’s second chance was just the beginning. As he reflects on the changes that occurred since his arrival, one thing is certain: The Great Tree Village is lively as always.

episodes.name: Welcome
episodes.overview: New residents mean building new homes. There's just one problem: regular houses do not fit the needs of minotaurs and centaurs.

episodes.name: New Residents
episodes.overview: A change of plans is in order. If the current village can't support the new residents, the solution is simple: build more villages.

episodes.name: Winter
episodes.overview: The Great Tree Village experiences another winter.

episodes.name: Martial Arts Competition
episodes.overview: What better way to mark a celebration than with a martial arts competition?

episodes.name: Another Peaceful Day
episodes.overview: From curing an illness to cultivating new crops to even Mountain Elves curating Hiraku’s favor, life in the Great Tree Village is never dull.

episodes.name: Fine Day for Vistors
episodes.overview: Hiraku has his hands full as mayor. Not only is he tasked with a series of angelic trials, but he must also mediate a draconic relationship.

episodes.name: Hot Spring Expedition
episodes.overview: A hot springs expedition quickly gets out of hand.

episodes.name: More Hot Spring Expedition
episodes.overview: They've dealt with the Lord of Death. Now they need to decide what to do with the black stones.

episodes.name: Return to Ordinary
episodes.overview: A feast celebrates the excavation of the black stones.

episodes.name: Festivities and Fuushu's Gratitude
episodes.overview: The passage of time brings change. A new competition is held, Alfred grows older, and new settlers arrive.

episodes.name: Castle in the Air
episodes.overview: The village must face a flying castle inhabited by demons.

episodes.name: A Village for All
episodes.overview: Hiraku establishes the newly powered Sun Castle as his fourth village. During a grand festival, he unveils a unifying flag while lightheartedly dodging pressure to take on a royal title.

titles.overview: They say whatever doesn’t kill you makes you stronger, but that’s not the case for the world’s weakest hunter Sung Jinwoo. After being brutally slaughtered by monsters in a high-ranking dungeon, Jinwoo came back with the System, a program only he could see, that’s leveling him up in every way. Now, he’s inspired to discover the secrets behind his powers and the dungeon that spawned them.

episodes.name: How to Get Stronger
episodes.overview: Jinwoo recaps the events of the story so far, from his humble beginnings as the Weakest Hunter of All Mankind to his newfound power and renewed purpose.

episodes.name: I'm Used to It
episodes.overview: Around ten years ago, gates that connected our world to another dimension began to appear, leading to the rise of hunters who would traverse these gates to fight the magic beasts within. Sung Jinwoo, E-Rank hunter, is the weakest of them all.

episodes.name: If I Had One More Chance
episodes.overview: Jinwoo and his party appear to have cleared a low-level dungeon, when a hidden path to an unfamiliar temple is revealed. There they encounter a set of commandments and a group of monsters that cause them absolute despair.

episodes.name: It's Like a Game
episodes.overview: Jinwoo remains behind in the temple dungeon to save his few surviving party members, and with a swing from the god statue's blade, his life comes to an end—or so it seems, before he wakes up in a hospital bed.

episodes.name: I've Gotta Get Stronger
episodes.overview: Having entered the instance dungeon located inside the subway, Jinwoo levels up time and time again by fighting waves of magic beasts. As he gradually makes his way forward, he finds a long stairway leading deeper underground.

episodes.name: A Pretty Good Deal
episodes.overview: Jinwoo joins a party led by Hwang Dongsuk to meet the headcount necessary for a C-Rank dungeon. Joined by another temporary hire, Yoo Jinho, the party defeats beasts without much trouble, but Jinwoo has suspicions about the group's lack of a healer.

episodes.name: The Real Hunt Begins
episodes.overview: While the C-Rank dungeon raid by Jinwoo and the others seems to be progressing well, the moment they step into an area covered in mana stones with a sleeping dungeon boss, things take a wrong turn.

episodes.name: Let's See How Far I Can Go
episodes.overview: As Jinwoo continues his training, he completes a daily quest one day by doing more than the quest requires, and a key that leads to a certain item appears in front of him.

episodes.name: This Is Frustrating
episodes.overview: Jinwoo answers a Hunter's Association request to take part in the raid of a D-Rank dungeon, where he encounters a few familiar faces.

episodes.name: You've Been Hiding Your Skills
episodes.overview: At the D-Rank raid, Jinwoo is reunited with four of the Cartenon Temple survivors. Together, they explore the dungeon with Kang Taeshik and his men. After splitting up, they hear a scream, and then...

episodes.name: What Is This, a Picnic?
episodes.overview: Jinwoo survives tragedy once again, but Woo Jinchul warns him that Hwang Dongsoo, an S-Rank hunter, may be after his life. Determined to grow stronger, Jinwoo teams up with Jinho to raid a succession of C-Rank dungeons, but they attract attention...

episodes.name: A Knight Who Defends an Empty Throne
episodes.overview: Out of the blue, a "job-change quest" pops up in Jinwoo's window. Feeling that it may help him get stronger, he enters the gate. Inside, he fights wave after wave of enemies, culminating in a knight who brings back memories of the Cartenon Temple.

episodes.name: Arise
episodes.overview: Drained from endless battle, Jinwoo sees a phantom of his past self. To overcome his own past as the Weakest Hunter of All Mankind, he struggles to find a way to clear the job-change quest.

episodes.name: You Aren't E-Rank, Are You
episodes.overview: After a scheduled meeting with Jinah's teachers, Jinwoo is asked to talk to one of her classmates, Han Song-yi, who is working as a hunter. In an effort to show her the harsh reality of the job, Jinwoo takes her to a raid designated for new hunters of the White Tiger guild.

episodes.name: I Suppose You Aren't Aware
episodes.overview: After being trapped inside of a red gate, Jinwoo has to contend with a bloodthirsty pack of ice elves who question his humanity.

episodes.name: Still a Long Way to Go
episodes.overview: Having completed his promise to Jinho to clear 19 dungeons, Jinwoo is stronger than he was when he fought the Cerberus. In order to gather the ingredients for the Elixir of Life and save his mother, he once again enters the S-Rank Demon's Castle dungeon.

episodes.name: I Need to Stop Faking
episodes.overview: Jinwoo realizes that he'll need to become even stronger in order to clear the Demon's Castle and decides to have his hunter rank reassessed.

episodes.name: This Is What We're Trained to Do
episodes.overview: Before attempting to finish the Demon's Castle, Jinwoo decides to earn some money to help prepare.

episodes.name: Don't Look Down on My Guys
episodes.overview: The Hunters Guild strike team is confronting the high orc shaman Kargalgan when Jinwoo crashes the fight.

episodes.name: The 10th S-Rank Hunter
episodes.overview: Jinwoo officially becomes an S-Rank hunter, allowing him to finalize his preparations for the Demon's Castle.

episodes.name: Looking Up Was Tiring Me Out
episodes.overview: Seeking the remaining ingredient for the Elixir of Life, Jinwoo continues his conquest of the Demon's Castle.

episodes.name: It Was All Worth It
episodes.overview: Jinwoo tries to cure his mother with the Elixir of Life while preparations for the 4th Jeju Island Raid begin.

episodes.name: We Need a Hero
episodes.overview: Sparks fly as the S-rank hunters spar in preparation for the Jeju Island raid.

episodes.name: It's Going to Get Even More Intense
episodes.overview: As the S-Rank hunters continue fighting, they're confronted by a new magic beast resembling a humanoid ant.

episodes.name: Are You the King of Humans
episodes.overview: Jinwoo arrives at Jeju Island to save the S-Rank hunters, but to do that he'll have to face the Ant King.

episodes.name: On to the Next Target
episodes.overview: After no shortage of hardship, the 4th Jeju Island raid comes to a close. But for Jinwoo, the hunt never ends.

titles.overview: In a bet to prove whether ghosts or aliens exist, two high schoolers face terrifying paranormal threats, gain superpowers and maybe even fall in love?!

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: When high schooler Momo, from a family of spirit mediums, first meets her classmate Okarun, an occult geek, they argue—Momo believes in ghosts but denies aliens, and Okarun believes in aliens but denies ghosts. When it turns out both phenomena are real, Momo awakens a hidden power and Okarun gains the power of a curse. Together, they must challenge the paranormal forces threatening their world.

episodes.name: That's How Love Starts, Ya Know!
episodes.overview: Momo believes in ghosts. Okarun believes in aliens. To make each other believe what they deny, they head to a spot famous for UFO sightings and a spiritual hotspot.

episodes.name: That's a Space Alien, Ain't It?!
episodes.overview: Momo awakens psychic powers, while Okarun is cursed by Turbo Granny. They evacuate to Momo's house, but a giant alien appears before them.

episodes.name: It's a Granny vs. Granny Clash!
episodes.overview: After Momo's grandmother temporarily suppresses the evil spirit within Okarun, she says that a game of tag may be the key to defeating it for good.

episodes.name: Kicking Turbo Granny's Ass
episodes.overview: Okarun and Momo arrive at the tunnel to confront Turbo Granny. Just when they think they've won, a giant crab spirit crashes through the wall.

episodes.name: Like, Where Are Your Balls?!
episodes.overview: Momo and Okarun’s ordeal with Turbo Granny has brought them closer, but things remain awkward between them. Okarun realizes he still has a problem.

episodes.name: A Dangerous Woman Arrives
episodes.overview: Turbo Granny reveals that Okarun's missing organs are contained within golden spheres. Aira, who has found one, now has the ability to see spirits.

episodes.name: To a Kinder World
episodes.overview: Momo and Okarun manage to weaken Acrobatic Silky but make a shocking discovery regarding Aira. Acrobatic Silky suggests a surprising way to help.

episodes.name: I've Got This Funny Feeling
episodes.overview: Aira begins to develop a crush on Okarun. As the three friends' emotions intertwine, they suddenly face another extraterrestrial emergency.

episodes.name: Merge! Serpo Dover Demon Nessie!
episodes.overview: Aira has awakened the powers of Acrobatic Silky within her and fights the Serpoians alongside Okarun and Momo.

episodes.name: Have You Ever Seen a Cattle Mutilation?
episodes.overview: Okarun and the girls try to clean up some misunderstandings with their classmates. The aquatic creature reappears before Momo and Aira.

episodes.name: First Love
episodes.overview: Momo's childhood friend Jiji has come to stay with the Ayases. He explains that he needs Seiko’s help with some strange phenomena at his house.

episodes.name: Let's Go to the Cursed House
episodes.overview: On the way to investigate the Enjoji house, Okarun feels uneasy about Jiji's closeness to Momo but finds himself drawn to his friendly nature.

episodes.name: Like, This Is the Legend of the Giant Snake
episodes.overview: As Momo fends off an attack in the outdoor hot spring, Okarun and Jiji panic over how to handle the mysterious room. The doorbell rings.

episodes.name: The Evil Eye
episodes.overview: In a bid to free Okarun and Momo from the Mongolian Death Worm’s psychic power, Jiji attempts to carry them to safety but runs into a powerful entity.

episodes.name: You Won't Get Away with This!
episodes.overview: Unwilling to leave Jiji behind, Okarun helps Momo escape to the surface. Momo then begins forming a plan to expose the Death Worm to sunlight.

episodes.name: That's, Like, Way Deadly!
episodes.overview: Momo tries to stop the magma, but the Kito family gets in her way. The tsuchinoko shrine priest joins the fray... but so does the possessed Jiji.

episodes.name: We Can All Stay There Together!
episodes.overview: With everyone safely back at Seiko's house, Momo and the others discover that water has a surprising effect on how Evil Eye possesses Jiji's body.

episodes.name: We Became a Family
episodes.overview: The hayashi musicians arrive and begin an energetic exorcism performance. But just when the ritual is about to succeed, Jiji makes a surprising plea.

episodes.name: Feeling Kinda Gloomy
episodes.overview: Okarun has an awkward time at the maid café where Momo works. Seiko tries teaching Jiji how to suppress Evil Eye's possession of his body.

episodes.name: You Can Do It, Okarun!
episodes.overview: Aira and Okarun battle the classical composer spirits. As Okarun struggles to avoid their attacks, Turbo Granny orders him to feel the rhythm.

episodes.name: I Want to Rebuild the House
episodes.overview: Putting his training to the test, Okarun goes all-out and holds his own against Evil Eye, but the effort causes him to revert to his human form.

episodes.name: The Secret Art of Being Attractive
episodes.overview: Momo goes to Okarun's classroom to tell him about the golden ball spotted in the housing complex and finds him speaking with a curious classmate.

episodes.name: Hey, It's a Kaiju
episodes.overview: The sky darkens as Momo, Okarun and Kinta try to evade the giant space monster. They soon run into Aira and Jiji, who give them some much-needed help.

episodes.name: Clash! Space Kaiju vs. Giant Robot!
episodes.overview: As Momo and the others try to pilot the giant Buddha robot and battle the kaiju, Okarun and Jiji are ejected from the robot and land in a rice paddy.

titles.overview: Yuji Itadori is a boy with tremendous physical strength, though he lives a completely ordinary high school life. One day, to save a classmate who has been attacked by curses, he eats the finger of Ryomen Sukuna, taking the curse into his own soul. From then on, he shares one body with Ryomen Sukuna. Guided by the most powerful of sorcerers, Satoru Gojo, Itadori is admitted to Tokyo Jujutsu High School, an organization that fights the curses... and thus begins the heroic tale of a boy who became a curse to exorcise a curse, a life from which he could never turn back.

episodes.name: New Year's Special
episodes.overview: The two voice actors Junya Enoki (Yuji Itadori) and Subaru Kimura (Aoi Todo) look back on the past 13 episodes and mention their favorite moments of the series.

episodes.name: Special Recap Episode
episodes.overview: Catch up on JUJUTSU KAISEN before the release of JUJUTSU KAISEN: Execution.

episodes.name: JUJUTSU KAISEN The Culling Game Special Episode
episodes.overview: A recap special covering events from the first seven episodes of the third season.

episodes.name: Ryomen Sukuna
episodes.overview: After visiting his beloved grandfather in the hospital, Yuji Itadori encounters an apprentice sorcerer who demands that Yuji hand over a cursed relic.

episodes.name: For Myself
episodes.overview: Yuji manages to control the curse of Ryomen Sukuna. Later, he awakens in a room with Jujutsu High teacher Satoru Gojo, who offers him a deadly choice.

episodes.name: Girl of Steel
episodes.overview: Nobara Kugisaki joins the class on a trip to Roppongi where Gojo gives her and Yuji their first test: dispel a curse from an abandoned building.

episodes.name: Curse Womb Must Die
episodes.overview: When a curse womb attacks a juvenile detention center, Yuji's group is called upon to rescue any remaining survivors — but combat isn’t an option.

episodes.name: Curse Womb Must Die -II-
episodes.overview: As Sukuna gruesomely holds Yuji's body hostage, Fushiguro struggles against the sheer strength of Sukuna's curse to buy time until Yuji can awaken.

episodes.name: After Rain
episodes.overview: Sukuna tells Yuji that he will bring him back to life on two conditions. Meanwhile, Suguru Geto and a cursed spirit discuss their plans for Gojo.

episodes.name: Assault
episodes.overview: The cursed spirit Jogo attacks Gojo, who has such little trouble fighting back that he leaves and brings back a student to observe the battle.

episodes.name: Boredom
episodes.overview: As Kugisaki and Fushiguro train for the exchange event, two older students from the Kyoto Jujutsu school arrive in Tokyo and pick a fight with them.

episodes.name: Small Fry and Reverse Retribution
episodes.overview: High schooler Junpei Yoshino finds his bullies horrifically killed in a movie theater. Sorcerer Kento Nanami and Yuji investigate the crime scene.

episodes.name: Idle Transfiguration
episodes.overview: Junpei gets some startling advice from Mahito. Later, Ijichi and Yuji track down Junpei and formulate a plan to set up a chance encounter with him.

episodes.name: Narrow-minded
episodes.overview: Annoyed at having to work off the clock, Nanami shows Mahito the true potential of his sorcery. Meanwhile, Yuji and Junpei bond over movies.

episodes.name: To You, Someday
episodes.overview: Ignoring Nanami's warning, Yuji dashes into the school and tries to reason with Junpei, but Mahito soon interrupts. Yuji appeals to Sukuna for help.

episodes.name: Tomorrow
episodes.overview: Yuji and Nanami coordinate their attacks on Mahito, wearing him down. But as the cursed spirit approaches death, he finds a new power within himself.

episodes.name: Kyoto Sister School Exchange Event - Group Battle 0 -
episodes.overview: With the exchange event between the Tokyo and Kyoto Jujutsu schools set to begin, Gojo arranges for Yuji to make a surprise appearance.

episodes.name: Kyoto Sister School Exchange Event - Group Battle 1 -
episodes.overview: Shortly after the exchange event team battle begins, Todo ambushes the Tokyo students. Yuji moves to stop him but soon finds himself surrounded.

episodes.name: Kyoto Sister School Exchange Event - Group Battle 2 -
episodes.overview: Todo gives Yuji advice on how to better tap into his curse powers. After Kugisaki taunts Nishimiya, Panda fights the remote-controlled Mechamaru.

episodes.name: Kyoto Sister School Exchange Event - Group Battle 3 -
episodes.overview: While Miwa struggles to stand her ground against Maki's attacks, Kugisaki chases down a flying Nishimiya, who lectures her about Mai's hardships.

episodes.name: Sage
episodes.overview: Fushiguro dodges Kamo's barrage of arrows but his opponent proves just as formidable in close combat. Meanwhile, Inumaki senses a foreboding presence.

episodes.name: Black Flash
episodes.overview: Inumaki, Fushiguro and Kamo struggle to hold their own against special grade cursed spirit Hanami, but Maki arrives to provide much-needed backup.

episodes.name: Nonstandard
episodes.overview: After analyzing Hanami's assortment of skills with his self-proclaimed intellect, Todo uses his disorienting technique to attack in tandem with Yuji.

episodes.name: Jujutsu Koshien
episodes.overview: After the event's interruption, the school tournament continues with a baseball match.

episodes.name: The Origin of Blind Obedience
episodes.overview: An investigation into a string of curse-related killings leads Yuji, Fushiguro and Kugisaki to the victims' – and Fushiguro's – former middle school.

episodes.name: The Origin of Blind Obedience -II-
episodes.overview: Fushiguro, Kugisaki and Itadori fight the cursed spirits on two fronts. When Fushiguro faces his enemy alone, he recalls his recent training with Gojo. He knows that he has to be able to surpass himself...

episodes.name: Accomplices
episodes.overview: Yuji and Nobara's battle against the Death Painting Wombs Kechizu and Eso reaches its conclusion! However, even in victory there is a cost in killing, something the Jujutsu High students had never considered before. Meanwhile, Choso, Geto and Mahito gain wind of this event.

episodes.name: Hidden Inventory
episodes.overview: The jujutsu sorcerers Iori Utahime and Mei Mei are dispatched to an ominous manor where several people have gone missing. They infiltrate the manor and attempt to destroy the cursed spirit's barrier, but suddenly the building starts to crumble.

episodes.name: Hidden Inventory 2
episodes.overview: Gojo and Geto are assigned to the mission of escorting and erasing the young girl compatible with the Tengen - the Star Plasma Vessel. Amanai Riko is being targeted by the Curse User Group Q, and the religious cult the Star Religious Group.

episodes.name: Hidden Inventory 3
episodes.overview: Gojo and Geto beat back the curse users after the bounty placed on Amanai's head when her cell phone rings. A captured Kuroi is displayed on her phone. Gojo tries to bring Amanai back to Jujutsu High, but she insists on going to the negotiations herself.

episodes.name: Hidden Inventory 4
episodes.overview: "Let's go home, Riko-chan." The moment Geto extends a hand to Amanai, the worst that could possibly happen does. Geto is left dumbstruck as Toji Fushiguro makes his appearance. Toji then declares that he killed Satoru Gojo.

episodes.name: Premature Death
episodes.overview: August 2007. Gojo starts to handle missions on his own, causing Geto to, as well. One day a certain individual appears before Geto. What's the conclusion that led to Gojo becoming the strongest jujutsu sorcerer, and Geto becoming the most evil curse user?

episodes.name: It's Like That
episodes.overview: 2018. After finishing a mission one day, Itadori decides to go to the movies, Kugisaki decides to go shopping, and Fushiguro tells them he's going home. After parting ways Kugisaki is approached by a woman who suddenly asks if she was with Itadori-kun.

episodes.name: Evening Festival
episodes.overview: The battle between Muta and Mahito continues and reaches its conclusion. Later, on October 31st, a veil is lowered over Shibuya and various jujutsu sorcerer teams assemble around the area.

episodes.name: Shibuya Incident
episodes.overview: Team Mei Mei are reassigned to a veil that has been lowered over Meiji Shrine Station. The team splits up and Yuji encounters a grasshopper curse assigned to protecting the veil. Elsewhere Satoru Gojo encounters Jogo, Hanami, and Choso.

episodes.name: Shibuya Incident - Gate, Open
episodes.overview: The battle between Satoru Gojo, Jogo, Hanami and Choso begins. Gojo informs Hanami that they will die first. Yuji encounters a woman who tells him that everyone was turned into monsters and boarded a train. As Gojo's battle continues, the train arrives.

episodes.name: Pandemonium
episodes.overview: Now that Satoru Gojo has been sealed, Mechamaru works with Team Mei Mei to inform them about what is going on and has them work on enacting his plan on what to do now.

episodes.name: Seance
episodes.overview: Nanami, Fushiguro, and Ino meet up with Itadori, then Nanami issues new orders for the others to work together to lift the veil keeping sorcerers out.

episodes.name: Dull Knife
episodes.overview: Yuji and Megumi lift the veil that was keeping sorcerers from entering Shibuya. Nobara and Nitta encounter Shigemo and a battle ensues. Shigemo has the upperhand, but then Nanami arrives with the deaths of the assistant supervisors in mind.

episodes.name: Red Scale
episodes.overview: Yuji makes his way to Shibuya Station where he's confronted by Choso. Choso unleashes his Convergence and the battle between him and Yuji commences.

episodes.name: Fluctuations
episodes.overview: Mei Mei and Ui Ui fight the Special-Grade Disease Curse summoned by whatever is pretending to be Suguru Geto. Meanwhile, Nanami joins up with Maki and Naobito, but they encounter a cursed spirit with unknown powers.

episodes.name: Fluctuations (2)
episodes.overview: Nanami, Maki, and Naobito are driven to the edge after the Special-Grade Cursed Spirit, Dagon, activates his Domain Expansion, Horizon of the Captivating Skandha. Fushiguro gives them a glimpse of a way to escape death, then Toji intrudes upon the fight.

episodes.name: Thunderclap
episodes.overview: Sukuna refuses to heed Jogo's advice after waking up, instead displaying his overwhelming strength against the Special-Grade Cursed Spirit, Jogo. Meanwhile, Fushiguro faces off against the rampant Toji with neither being aware of the other's identity.

episodes.name: Thunderclap (2)
episodes.overview: After being severely injured in his fight against Toji, Fushiguro suffers a surprise attack from Shigemo. On the verge of death, Fushiguro desperately heads toward Dougenzaka crossing and summons a certain Shikigami with his Ten Shadows Technique.

episodes.name: Right and Wrong
episodes.overview: Itadori reawakens with grievous resolve as he bears witness to the aftermath Sukuna has wrought upon Shibuya. Meanwhile, Nanami continues to fight through packs of transfigured humans in an exhausted haze until Mahito appears before him.

episodes.name: Right and Wrong (2)
episodes.overview: Itadori launches into a back-and-forth battle against Mahito, but he struggles against Mahito's ploy of using average people against him. Meanwhile, Kugisaki encounters one of Mahito's separated bodies as she returns to the battlefield.

episodes.name: Right and Wrong (3)
episodes.overview: Itadori stands in a daze at the disaster before his eyes, his mind already well past its limit. As a curse, Mahito is elated at seeing his ideal sequence of events play out before him, and he prepares to further finish off Itadori.

episodes.name: Metamorphosis
episodes.overview: After rescuing Itadori from his predicament, Todo bolsters his morale and encourages him to stand back up. As Mahito kicks things into higher gear, he begins using Soul Multiplicity and Body Repel to unleash omnidirectional attacks.

episodes.name: Metamorphosis (2)
episodes.overview: The moment it appeared Itadori and Mahito's battle to the death was resolved, the being wearing Geto's body asked, "Shall I save you, Mahito?" Itadori immediately recognizes the man before him as the very same one who sealed away Gojo and leaps to attack.

episodes.name: Shibuya Incident - Gate, Close
episodes.overview: Choso begins to realize the identity of the mastermind parasitizing Geto's corpse as sorcerers gather for the final moments of the Shibuya Incident. The special-grade sorcerer, Yuki Tsukumo, comes to the rescue when they're on the verge of death.

episodes.name: Execution
episodes.overview: While Yuji grapples with the weight of his sins, Naoya Zen'in and Yuta Okkotsu set out to execute him.

episodes.name: One More Time
episodes.overview: After fighting Yuta, Yuji learns his real objective. Megumi asks for Yuji's help to save his sister.

episodes.name: About the Culling Game
episodes.overview: Itadori and his friends speak with Tengen about Kenjaku's objectives and their plans for the Culling Game.

episodes.name: Perfect Preparation
episodes.overview: After going to collect their Cursed Tools, Maki awakens her true potential & slaughters the whole Zen'in Clan.

episodes.name: Passion
episodes.overview: Yaga is executed. Yuji and Fushiguro go to Hakari's fight club hoping to meet him and recruit him.

episodes.name: Cog
episodes.overview: Fushiguro and Panda fight Kirara to try and persuade them while Yuji attempts to convince Hakari.

episodes.name: Tokyo Colony No. 1
episodes.overview: Yuji's group enters two of the colonies and fight the Culling Game's newbie hunters.

episodes.name: Tokyo Colony No. 1 (2)
episodes.overview: Yuji meets Higuruma and tries to persuade him, while Fushiguro is falsely led to Reggie.

episodes.name: Tokyo Colony No. 1 (3)
episodes.overview: Yuji Itadori fights Hiromi Higuruma.

episodes.name: Tokyo Colony No. 1 (4)
episodes.overview: Takaba handles the minions while Fushiguro has his showdown with Reggie.

episodes.name: Tokyo Colony No. 1 (5)
episodes.overview: Fushiguro deploys his Domain Expansion in his climatic fight against Reggie.

episodes.name: Sendai Colony
episodes.overview: Okkotsu fights three powerful sorcerers in Sendai Colony.

titles.overview: A spy, an assassin and a telepath come together to pose as a family, each for their own reasons, while hiding their true identities from each other.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A spy, an assassin and a telepath come together to pose as a family, each for their own reasons, while hiding their true identities from each other.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Yor and Loid may be keeping their true identities from each other, but telepathic Anya knows everything. Now, as they set sail on a luxury cruise, Yor must stop a group of assassins from reaching their target—while Loid struggles with a different mission altogether: figuring out what a good father is supposed to do on vacation.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: The cold war between Ostania and Westalis continues with a terrible strawberry shortage. Fiona Frost, AKA Nightfall, tries to solve the crisis before it becomes too much. Perhaps, the bigger question is whether or not the entire Forger family can thwart an enraged construction worker from going on a rampage without letting each other in on their secrets.

episodes.name: Spy x Family Movie: Code: White Manner Movie
episodes.overview: Wit Studio and Cloverworks released a new short film using Spy x Family to remind the general public of basic movie theater etiquette. You’ll be able to watch it from all Toho cinemas in Japan. All members of the immediate Forger family are present. It focuses on Loid and Yor teaching Anya how to behave when in a movie theater.

episodes.name: Street Fighter 6 x Spy x Family Movie: Code: White
episodes.overview: A short animated collaboration promoting Spy x Family Movie: Code: White and the video game Street Fighter 6.

episodes.name: Ayataka Spy x Family Movie Campaign Ayataka de Hotto Hitoiki
episodes.overview: A commercial between Spy x Family Movie: Code: White and Ayataka featuring the Forger family having a picnic under the cherry blossoms while drinking Ayataka tea.

episodes.name: OPERATION STRIX
episodes.overview: Twilight is an agent that works for WISE, Westalis's intelligence agency, and he is tasked with investigating Desmond, who is in Ostania and planning to start a war. Twilight disguises himself as the psychiatrist Loid Forger and adopts a girl named Anya so that he can enroll her into the prestigious Eden College to get closer to his target. Unbeknownst to him, Anya is actually a telepath who can read people's minds. One day, members of a mafia group that is after Twilight kidnaps Anya. Loid realizes that he needs to reconsider his priorities and...

episodes.name: SECURE A WIFE
episodes.overview: Civil servant Yor Briar has a secret identity: an assassin named the Thorn Princess. Lately, single women had been suspected of being spies, which was making Yor nervous. Meanwhile, Loid was searching for someone to play Anya's mother so they could attend the interview at Eden College. He just happens to run into Yor at a boutique. Anya reads Yor's mind and finds out that she's an assassin and tries to get Loid to ask Yor to play her mother.

episodes.name: PREPARE FOR THE INTERVIEW
episodes.overview: Yor moves in with Loid and Anya. Now that they are a family, they need to prepare for the interview. But Loid realizes with how Anya and Yor currently are, the interview probably won't go well. In order to make sure they all understand how an upper-class family should be, Loid decides that they should all go out as a family. They go to the theatre and a museum, but it's just not clicking with Anya and Yor. Twilight begins to lose hope, but...

episodes.name: THE PRESTIGIOUS SCHOOL'S INTERVIEW
episodes.overview: The day they had been preparing for has finally arrived! The Forgers are fully prepared and head to the interview. As soon as they enter the school grounds, Loid feels someone watching them. All of the applicants were being observed from the shadows by the instructors of the academy. The exam had already begun. Housemaster Henderson, who would be grading their performance, kept a keen eye on how the Forgers were acting and seeing if they were truly worthy of the prestigious Eden College.

episodes.name: WILL THEY PASS OR FAIL?
episodes.overview: The day that Eden College would announce the applicants that successfully got into the school had finally arrived, but Anya's number is not listed. The Forgers fall into the depths of despair but are greeted by Henderson. He praises them for their interview and tells them that Anya is at the top of the waiting list. Three days later, they find out that Anya got into the school! Franky comes over to celebrate with the Forgers and they all agree to reward Anya for working so hard. What Anya asks for...

episodes.name: THE FRIENDSHIP SCHEME
episodes.overview: Anya's uniform is finished. Loid has to go to a WISE strategy meeting, so he has Yor pick up the uniform as he heads to the safehouse. At the meeting, he finds out that Anya will have to receive 8 Stellar Stars and become an Imperial Scholar at Eden College in order for him to successfully complete Operation Strix. Meanwhile, Anya is very excited about getting her new uniform. But there are always criminals on the lookout for wealthy students from Eden College and Anya gets targeted by a group of hoodlums.

episodes.name: THE TARGET'S SECOND SON
episodes.overview: Anya ends up with a Tonitrus Bolt after she hit Damian Desmond. Sadly, this causes her to stand out for the wrong reasons in class which depresses her, but she ends up friends with Becky, and school becomes a little more fun. She also tries to apologize to Damian for hitting him, but just can't seem to get the words out. For the sake of Operation Strix, Loid disguises himself as someone who works at the school and tries to help Anya reconcile from the shadows, but...

episodes.name: THE COUNTER-SECRET POLICE COVER OPERATION
episodes.overview: Ostania's counterintelligence agency and national security bureau conducts spy hunts and keeps surveillance on its citizens to maintain peace within the country. They are also called the Secret Police and are feared. Yor's younger brother Yuri actually belongs to the Secret Police and is hunting down spies while keeping this a secret from Yor and others around him. One day, he suddenly shows up at the Forger residence. The Forgers, who are full of secrets, and Yuri, who has a secret identity, come face to face!

episodes.name: SHOW OFF HOW IN LOVE YOU ARE
episodes.overview: In order to prove to Yuri that they are actually a married couple, Loid and Yor are supposed to kiss. Loid is willing to get this done immediately for the sake of Operation Strix, but Yor can't do this sober, so she ends up downing a bunch of wine and gets drunk. Yuri sees his sister this way, also gets drunk, and is unable to make rational decisions anymore...

episodes.name: THE GREAT DODGEBALL PLAN
episodes.overview: A rumor spreads amongst the first graders at Eden College saying that if they do well in their next PE class, they will get rewarded with Stella Stars. Anya is determined to get a Stella Star, so she trains with Yor. Thus begins the dodgeball match between Cecile Hall and Wald Hall! Anya and her classmates are determined to win, but they are faced with the giant, Bill Watkins.

episodes.name: STELLA
episodes.overview: In order for parents to attend one of the social gatherings at Eden College, their children need to be Imperial Scholars, but Anya hating to study makes this rather difficult. Loid then comes up with a plan to get Anya to get Stella Stars by doing community service rather than with her academics. But when she ends up volunteering at a hospital, she continuously messes up. Later, she hears a child drowning in a pool with her telepathy and...

episodes.name: PENGUIN PARK
episodes.overview: Loid is burdened with one mission after another from WISE and comes home exhausted. He then hears neighbors gossiping that he's neglecting his family. Because he can't let anyone doubt them as a family for the sake of Operation Strix, he decides to take his family to the aquarium the next day they have off to show everyone that they get along. However, he is assigned another mission from WISE while he's there, and...

episodes.name: PROJECT APPLE
episodes.overview: The Forgers go look for a dog for Anya's reward for getting a Stella. In the middle of their outing, Loid ends up having to work a mission to stop a terrorist bombing attack planned against Westalis's foreign minister. Meanwhile, Anya is trying to pick out a dog, but then sees a vision of her family when she randomly reads the mind of a giant, mysterious, white dog. Anya becomes curious and chases after the dog, but she ends up accidentally wandering into the hideout of the terrorists!

episodes.name: DISARM THE TIME BOMB
episodes.overview: Anya meets a mysterious dog who can see into the future. They were able to escape from the terrorists with the dog's help, but eventually, they fall back into the hands of the terrorists again. And then Yor shows up and attacks the enemy! Soon after, the dog sees into the future again. The vision Anya saw through the dog's mind was Loid unconscious and buried under the remains of a building that had been bombed. In order to stop this future from happening, Anya and the dog head to the place where the incident happens!

episodes.name: A NEW FAMILY MEMBER
episodes.overview: Loid faces off with one of the enemy's bomb dogs, Anya secretly saves Loid, and Yor finds the leader of the terrorists who had been on the run. The whole family ends up involved in this terrorist bombing incident, but what will be its conclusion?! Also, they were supposed to go get a dog for Anya as a reward for her getting a Stella, but now, she says she wants to keep the mysterious, giant dog that she encounters in this incident. Loid knows the truth about this dog as well as the other dogs involved in the bombing incident and tells her no, but then Anya says she'll quit going to school if she can't have the dog and...

episodes.name: YOR'S KITCHEN / THE INFORMANT'S GREAT ROMANCE PLAN
episodes.overview: Why has Yor been coming home late every night, her hands covered in cuts? Why has Franky asked Loid to meet him under mysterious and urgent circumstances? These are two tales of misadventure while seeking happiness in Berlint.

episodes.name: CARRY OUT THE GRIFFIN PLAN / FULLMETAL LADY / OMELET RICE ♥
episodes.overview: Anya and the rest of her class have an arts and crafts lesson where Anya is put in the same group as Damian. Sylvia goes about an ordinary work day. We learn the secret source of Yuri's strength.

episodes.name: UNCLE THE PRIVATE TUTOR / DAYBREAK
episodes.overview:
Next week is Eden College's midterms. That week happens to include the new moon, the one day of the month Anya can't use her powers to cheat. But then, Yor suggests that Yuri should be her tutor...

The midterms are over. Loid is nervous about Anya's test scores and heads to Eden College to alter the answers. However, there already seems to be another guy there with the same motive that's making himself insanely suspicious and obvious?!

episodes.name: A REVENGE PLOT AGAINST DESMOND / MAMA BECOMES THE WIND
episodes.overview:
Damian does well on his midterms, so he earns a Stella. Everyone around him is now praising him, but for some reason, his classmate George seems to be looking at him begrudgingly. The reason being...

After seeing Anya off to school, Yor finds Anya's gym clothes on top of her desk. At this rate, Anya will surely have trouble in her gym class. Yor runs to deliver the forgotten clothes!

episodes.name: INVESTIGATE THE GENERAL HOSPITAL / DECIPHER THE PERPLEXING CODE
episodes.overview:
Anya has to write a report about an occupation she's interested in, so she ends up going to Loid's place of work, Berlint General Hospital. As soon as Loid was out of sight, Anya starts to explore!

Anya becomes very interested in deciphering codes after seeing it done in her spy cartoon, so she makes her own code and sends Loid and the others secret messages. Will they be able to crack the codes?!

episodes.name: NIGHTFALL / FIRST FIT OF JEALOUSY
episodes.overview:
Fiona, who works at Loid's hospital, happens to actually be the female WISE agent Nightfall. She is irritated that Operation Strix is facing delays, so she suggests that she becomes Mrs. Forger instead. She also decides to show up at the Forger household unannounced and comes face to face with Yor!

Anya loves the penguin plushie that Loid got for her, and even sleeps with it. However, a pale shadow shoots jealous glares in the penguin's general direction...

episodes.name: THE UNDERGROUND TENNIS TOURNAMENT: THE CAMPBELLDON
episodes.overview: The secret files called the Zacharis Dossier may cause a war between the East and the West. In order to obtain a painting that is supposed to be the hiding spot for these files, Loid and Fiona enter an underground tennis tournament run by the owner of the painting, Campbell. If they win, the art piece they're after will be presented. Loid and Fiona enter as a married couple and play various skilled players including pro players!

episodes.name: THE UNWAVERING PATH
episodes.overview: The underground tennis tournament is finally heading to the final match. The Campbell siblings that Loid and Fiona are up against are playing dirty, as they have altered tennis rackets as well as the staff helping them out. But the spy pair from WISE overcome one obstacle after another and Loid deals the final blow! But right after the match, the State Security Service finds out about the dossier and infiltrates the tournament...

episodes.name: THE ROLE OF A MOTHER AND WIFE / SHOPPING WITH FRIENDS
episodes.overview:
Yor becomes anxious about their pretend marriage after Fiona shows up. Loid notices this and thinks that Yor had started to develop romantic feelings towards him. For the sake of the mission, he flips on his Twilight mode.

Becky takes Anya to the department store so they can buy Anya some cute clothes. She uses her rich girl powers and rents out a whole shop where they start their own little fashion show.

episodes.name: FIRST CONTACT
episodes.overview: A social gathering happens at Eden College once every half term. It is a strictly guarded event where only Imperial Scholars and their parents, the VIPs of Ostania, are allowed to go. Damian tells his brother that he'd like to see their father when he attends the event. Loid finds out about that and uses Damian to get close to his target.

episodes.name: FOLLOW MAMA AND PAPA
episodes.overview: Yor is shot in the butt while on a mission and looks miserable when she gets home. Loid mistakes her very apparent miserable mood as her being unhappy with their marriage of convenience and offers to take her out on a date.

episodes.name: BOND'S STRATEGY TO STAY ALIVE / DAMIAN'S FIELD RESEARCH TRIP
episodes.overview: Bond sees an ominous future and believes that it's Yor's food that's going to cause it. In order to change this fate, Bond leaves the house to search for Loid! Henderson orders Damian, Emil, and Ewen to go on a field research trip with Mr. Green.

episodes.name: MISSION AND FAMILY / THE ELEGANT BONDMAN / THE HEART OF A CHILD / WAKING UP
episodes.overview: Yuri is doing great at his job with the Secret Police. His assignment today is to investigate a former newspaper reporter suspected of selling articles slandering Ostania to Westalis. Anya's favorite cartoon hero Bondman shows off his elegant spy moves!!

episodes.name: THE PASTRY OF KNOWLEDGE / THE INFORMANT'S GREAT ROMANCE PLAN II
episodes.overview: Eden's legendary dessert finally appears! In order to obtain the macaroons that supposedly can make you into an Imperial Scholar if eaten, Anya and her friends race to get to them first.

episodes.name: PLAN TO CROSS THE BORDER
episodes.overview: On a mission as Thorn Princess and using her job as city hall as a cover, Yor is tasked with protecting the only survivors of the Gretcher family, Olka and her son, and helping them escape to a different country by traveling on a cruise ship.

episodes.name: THE FEARSOME LUXURY CRUISE SHIP
episodes.overview: After boarding the cruise ship, Yor began her duty as bodyguard to Olka and her son. Meanwhile, Yor's superior, Matthew, finds an assassin who is after Olka and her son.

episodes.name: WHO IS THIS MISSION FOR?
episodes.overview: Loid tries to pick out souvenirs that will make him look like a fun and happy dad so he can cheer Anya up. Meanwhile, Yor was facing off with Sickle-and-Chain Barnaby.

episodes.name: THE SYMPHONY UPON THE SHIP
episodes.overview: The deck is filled with passengers enjoying the fireworks show. Anya and Loid were also enjoying the fireworks. Meanwhile, Yor's mission finally reaches its climax. She tries to help Olka and the others escape, but they are surrounded by assassins!

episodes.name: THE HAND THAT CONNECTS TO THE FUTURE
episodes.overview: Due to the movements the State Security Service members were making, Loid finds out that there was a bomb on the ship. Loid leaves Anya at the daycare in a hurry then disguises himself as a State Security Service member to take care of the bomb.

episodes.name: ENJOY THE RESORT TO THE FULLEST / BRAGGING ABOUT VACATION
episodes.overview: The morning after the attack from the assassins and the bomb scare, the cruise ship arrives at the resort island. Loid and Anya meet up with Yor and the three enjoy a family vacation!

episodes.name: BERLINT IN LOVE / NIGHTFALL'S DAILY LIFE
episodes.overview: Becky is very excited about a romantic drama on TV, so she heads over to the Forgers' place to see Loid, who she fell in love with instantly after seeing his picture. Becky aggressively pursues Loid.

episodes.name: PART OF THE FAMILY
episodes.overview: As Bond is on a walk with Loid, he has a premonition of an accident, so he tries to stop it, but is scolded by Loid. He then sees a vision of a building going up in flames and a sobbing girl standing in front of it.

episodes.name: Berlint Panic | The Informant and Nightfall
episodes.overview: The Forgers enjoy a day off while Nightfall hires Franky to help her on a mission.

episodes.name: Avoid Getting Tonitrus Bolts | ■■■■'s Memories I
episodes.overview: Anya's class must avoid getting Tonitrus Bolts and we get a glimpse into someone's past.

episodes.name: ■■■■'s Memories II
episodes.overview: Loid recalls what happened in the past that led him to where he is today.

episodes.name: Behind the Scandal | The Path to an Imperial Scholar
episodes.overview: WISE agents protect an opera singer and Henderson gives Anya tips on becoming an Imperial Scholar.

episodes.name: The Mommy-Friends Scheme
episodes.overview: Yor goes out shopping and happens to save someone quite unexpected.

episodes.name: White Jealousy | The Eden College Busjacking Incident
episodes.overview: A doctor's jealousy gets Loid into some trouble at the hospital and Anya's class goes on a field trip.

episodes.name: The Red Circus
episodes.overview: A bus carrying Anya's class is busjacked by some terrorists.

episodes.name: Take Down the Busjacker
episodes.overview: Henderson gets on the bus to give the children food and water. Billy remembers his purpose in life.

episodes.name: Anya's Era Has Come
episodes.overview: Anya, Becky, Damian, and Bill are given Stella Stars for their quick thinking during the busjacking.

episodes.name: Austin's Troubles | A Normal Mixer | Moon Landing
episodes.overview: Mr. Austin is having nightmares after the busjacking incident and Yor goes out with her coworkers.

episodes.name: Extreme Level 3 Situation
episodes.overview: Twilight and Yuri get an emergency summons from their respective agencies.

episodes.name: Battle to the Death in the Sewers
episodes.overview: The WISE agents and the State Security Service agents clash in the sewers.

episodes.name: A World Where We Cannot Survive
episodes.overview: The battle in the sewers reaches its conclusion and Loid tries to remedy his relationship with Yor.

titles.overview: Denji has a simple dream—to live a happy and peaceful life, spending time with a girl he likes. This is a far cry from reality, however, as Denji is forced by the yakuza into killing devils in order to pay off his crushing debts. Using his pet devil Pochita as a weapon, he is ready to do anything for a bit of cash.

episodes.name: DOG & CHAINSAW
episodes.overview:
Denji is a teenager who lives his life as a Devil Hunter.

Aiming to pay off the debt he inherited from his father, he starts hunting devils for the yakuza with his buddy Pochita, a "Chainsaw Devil", while living a tragically poor life.

Just when things seem like they couldn't get any worse, Denji gets betrayed and killed by the yakuza. As Denji starts passing out, he hears someone calling from inside his head...

episodes.name: ARRIVAL IN TOKYO
episodes.overview:
After being taken into custody by Makima, one of the Public Safety Devil Hunters, Denji finds himself head over heels in love with her thanks to her suggestive insinuations.

Wishing to team up with Makima, Denji arrives at the Devil Hunters Headquarters in Tokyo, and gets introduced to Aki Hayakawa, a senior hunter that he was supposed to partner with. But then Hayakawa beats Denji up, and demands that he “quit this job”...

episodes.name: MEOWY'S WHEREABOUTS
episodes.overview:
Denji decides that his new dream is "to fondle some boobs."

His partner, Power the Blood Fiend, offers to let him feel her boobs only if he rescues her old pet cat Meowy from a devil.

With his dream in sight, Denji is all fired up and ready to go, until...

episodes.name: RESCUE
episodes.overview:
After a fierce battle, Denji defeats the “Bat Devil” and rescues Power even after she had trapped him.

He says it is all for the sake of “touching Power’s boobs”.

Power mocks his ridiculous motivation saying “that’s a pretty dumb reason”, but still agrees to let him fondle her boobs.

As Denji gets thrilled with the idea, he faces a sudden attack from out of nowhere...

episodes.name: GUN DEVIL
episodes.overview:
Aki Hayakawa, Denji, and Power start living together.

Denji finally fulfills his dream of touching Power’s boobs, but is shocked when things do not turn out the way he expected.  As Denji realizes that chasing his dream was more fun than achieving it, Makima approaches him and says, "If you can kill the Gun Devil, I’ll grant you one wish.”

episodes.name: KILL DENJI
episodes.overview:
Denji and Tokyo Special Division 4 members enter a hotel to collect a piece of the Gun Devil. However, they end up being trapped on the 8th floor due to the devil’s extraordinary power.

With the members being cornered on the endless 8th floor with seemingly no way to escape, the devil makes them an offer: “If you let me eat Denji, I will let all of the other devil hunters leave in one piece.”

episodes.name: THE TASTE OF A KISS
episodes.overview:
Aki gets stabbed by Kobeni while protecting Denji. Seeing this, Denji jumps inside the “Eternity Devil” and starts attacking it. He fails to kill the “Eternity Devil” and his chainsaw power ends up fading after losing too much blood. But then, he manages to restore his power after eating the devil’s flesh and drinking its blood, and begins to fight back.

As Himeno watches Denji, she remembers the saying, “The Devil Hunters that devils fear are the ones with a few screws loose...”

episodes.name: GUNFIRE
episodes.overview:
Denji experiences his first, yet devastating, kiss.

An intoxicated Denji is taken to Himeno's house, where she starts seducing him. Feeling torn between Makima, whom he admires, and Himeno, who is standing in front of him, he decides to fall into temptation. However, Denji then finds something in his pocket: The Chupa Chups lollipop that Makima gave him.

episodes.name: FROM KYOTO
episodes.overview: A fierce battle unfolds between Denji and the menacing Samurai Sword. But even after Denji takes one of Samurai Sword's companions hostage, Samurai Sword slashes through them both until Denji is captured. Meanwhile, after seemingly being killed, Makima turns out to be alive. She sets out to rescue Denji with the help of Public Safety Devil Hunters from Kyoto, Kurose and Tendo.

episodes.name: BRUISED & BATTERED
episodes.overview:
Samurai Sword's vicious attack resulted in many lost personnel for Public Safety Devil Extermination Division 4.

Aki Hayakawa wakes up in a hospital bed, unable to accept the reality of losing Himeno. Kurose and Tendo then appear in front of Hayakawa, letting him know that they are now in charge of coaching him.

Meanwhile, Makima introduces Denji and Power to a member of Public Safety who will act as their mentor in order to strengthen Division 4.

episodes.name: MISSION START
episodes.overview:
Denji and Power complete their training with Kishibe, while Aki Hayakawa makes a new contract with the "Future Devil" through Kurose and Tendo.

Meanwhile, Makima threatens the yakuza boss into revealing the names of all those who have made contracts with the "Gun Devil," along with the location of Samurai Sword's hideout.

The time has finally come for Public Safety to begin their counterattack against Samurai Sword and his companions.

episodes.name: KATANA VS. CHAINSAW
episodes.overview:
Sawatari sends the "Ghost Devil" after Hayakawa, and he's nearly killed before the "Ghost Devil" stops and hands him a cigarette with a message from Himeno. The words inside give Hayakawa the strength to kill the “Ghost Devil” and capture Sawatari.

Meanwhile, Denji heads into his rematch with Samurai Sword. With a pull of the starter on his chest, he transforms into Chainsaw Man.

And now, the last battle between Chainsaw Man and Samurai Sword has finally begun...

titles.overview: For a thousand years, the Vikings have made quite a name and reputation for themselves as the strongest families with a thirst for violence.
